You will own the day-to-day experience of our customers and support outreach to partners, educators, and brands. This is a hands-on role — you will be calling real mothers, building real relationships, and making things happen.



What You Will Own



Customer Success

Call at least 1 customer daily to check in, gather feedback, and build loyalty

Be the first point of contact for delivery issues, complaints, and order queries, resolve warmly and promptly

Maintain a live error log for delivery and fulfilment issues and ensure appropriate compensation is actioned

Manage and grow the Milkforbubs VIP list, track top spenders monthly, coordinate freebies and discounts with ops, and personally call VIPs to inform them of new launches and events

Ensure all customer messages across channels (DMs, email, comments) are replied to in a warm and timely manner

Compile a weekly customer feedback summary for the Founder highlighting recurring themes, complaints, and praise



Partnerships — Execution

Follow up on partnership leads opened by the Founder — maintain a live tracker of all outreach, follow-ups, and outcomes

Coordinate with Mummy's Market on logistics, samples, giveaways, and feature placements

Reach out to aligned brands for giveaway and collab opportunities (using templates and scripts provided)

Liaise with lactation counsellors, dietitians, and doulas for content alignment and collaboration

Coordinate sample pack preparation and distribution logistics in partnership with operations

Support outreach to confinement food providers, nanny agencies, and postnatal massage therapists for sample distribution

Coordinate stroller brand and baby product brand partnerships for sample bag inclusion



TikTok Shop & Shopee Affiliate

Maintain affiliate tracker — ensure all active affiliates are onboarded, briefed, and monitored

Flag performance issues and escalate to Founder for strategic decisions



What You Will NOT Be Doing

To be clear about scope: this is a coordinator role, not a BD or strategy role.

You will not be cold-opening relationships with hospitals (KKH, Thomson, NUHS) — the Founder leads these

You will not negotiate or close brand partnership contracts

You will not make strategic decisions on product placement or pricing



Bonus Points

Experience in a DTC, F&B, or mother-and-baby brand

Familiarity with Shopee, TikTok Shop, or Shopify

Has been pregnant or is a mother herself — you get the community from the inside

Experience with CRM tools or customer tracking systems



Escalation Guide

You are empowered to resolve the following independently:

Delivery delays — offer discount code or resend (within approved limits)

Wrong item sent — coordinate replacement with ops

General complaints — acknowledge, apologise, resolve, log

Giveaway logistics and sample coordination



Escalate to Founder for:

Any compensation above SGD 50 in value

Media or press enquiries

Partnership proposals requiring a contract or formal agreement

Customer escalations involving legal threats or public complaints

Any hospital or healthcare institution outreach



What We Offer

A meaningful role in a brand that genuinely improves mothers' lives

Direct access to and mentorship from the Founder

Small team culture — your work is visible and your impact is real

Staff discount on all Milkforbubs products

Opportunity to grow into a senior role as the business scales



Working hours to follow Singapore working hours timing 8am-6pm with an hour break.

Do apply with the word "pineapple" in your resume/cover. Applicants without the word pineapple will not be considered.

Public holiday to follow Singapore's arrangement.

Please note that there will be a verbal reasoning test needed for this role

Please also note that we will require a voice note to be sent as role requires speaking directly to our customers.

The Role

 community.



Your mission is to take what is already working on Instagram and

title: AI-Assisted Customer Support Specialist (Email & Social Media) | US Shopify Brand | Full Time
description:
➤ Who we are

We are a fast-growing DTC e-commerce brand selling to women in the US, Canada and the UK. Orders are growing fast. Our support team has five full-time agents today, and the volume now needs more.

We are not the average e-commerce brand that stops caring once the order is paid. We want every customer happy, and a brand reputation that is spotless. That is why this role matters to us.



➤ This is not a typing job. It's a thinking job.

Customer support here is not about writing replies anymore. Our AI drafts the replies, and most of them are already very good.

Your job is to think: read every draft, check the order and the facts, fix what's wrong, and what gets sent. You will work with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) all day. We need a sharp brain, not a fast typist.

And you own your queue. Every customer gets an answer. Every order problem gets followed until it is solved. Nothing gets forgotten. You don't need anyone to remind you.



➤ The team and your shift

Support here runs around the clock, in three 8-hour shifts (Philippine time):

• Afternoon and evening: 1:00 PM to 9:00 PM

• Graveyard: 9:00 PM to 5:00 AM

• Morning: 5:00 AM to 1:00 PM

In the application form, tell us every shift you can work. We agree on yours together, and then it stays fixed.

Whatever your shift, the job is the same:

• You own the queue while you are on. Every customer gets an answer, every order problem gets followed.

• On the days one of your teammates is off, you carry a bigger part of the queue.

• Before you log off, you brief the next agent: what happened, what is open, what to watch.



➤ What you will do

Customers always come first: support and comments are your priority every day. Supplier follow-ups fill the rest of your shift, and creator partnerships come later.



1. Customer support, AI-assisted

• Review every AI-drafted reply in our inbox (Help Scout): check the order in Shopify and the tracking, correct or rewrite with AI when needed, then send.

• Handle order status, shipping delays, returns, refunds, exchanges and address changes.

• Handle sensitive cases calmly: upset customers, disputes and chargebacks.

• Spot when the AI gets something wrong, and report it so the system keeps getting better.



2. Social media moderation

• Check comments on our and Instagram pages and ads, every day.

• Reply, hide spam, and turn public complaints into solved tickets.



3. Supplier and fulfillment follow-up

• Follow up with our supplier and fulfillment partners on delayed, lost or wrong orders.

• Make sure every stuck order gets a solution, and the customer hears about it.



4. Content creator partnerships (later, as the role grows)

• We are starting to work with content creators and influencers. It is close to customer support: you write to people, answer their questions, and follow up until it is done.

• Reach out to creators, coordinate product shipments, and track the content we receive.

• This is not for day one. It comes when support is under control and you have time in your shift.



➤ Schedule

• Full time, 6 days a week. One fixed day off, agreed together. It cannot be Saturday, Sunday or Monday.

• One fixed shift, agreed together (see the three shifts above): 8 hours with 1 hour of breaks inside, so 7 hours of work a day. No split shift.

• The shift can move by one hour when the US changes its clocks.

• Being open to a 7th day during peak season is a big plus (paid extra).

• 100% remote, from the South East Asia time zone (Philippines preferred). Fast, reliable internet and a backup plan for power outages.

• Start: as soon as possible.



➤ Who you are

• Must have: 2+ years of customer support for an e-commerce brand on Shopify. This is required.

• Must have: you already use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude or similar) regularly. If you don't use AI today, this role is not for you. We will train you on our system.

• A sharp, analytical mind: you read carefully, check the facts, and catch mistakes, including the AI's.

• Excellent written English: warm, clear and professional.

• Organized and detail-oriented. To prove it: in the application form, start your answer about the Shopify brands you supported with the word banana.

• Responsible. You follow up without being reminded, and you bring solutions, not only problems.

• Experience with a helpdesk (Help Scout, Gorgias, Zendesk or similar).

• Experience with
 and Instagram comment moderation.

• Bonus: experience talking to suppliers or fulfillment partners.

• Bonus: experience with influencer or content creator (UGC) outreach.



➤ What's in it for you

💰 $800 a month, paid on time, twice a month.

📊 Performance bonuses.

🕐 A fixed shift, chosen with you. No split shift, no schedule that changes every week.

🚀 Room to grow: more responsibility and a higher salary as the brand grows.

🤝 A long-term, stable role with a brand that is actively scaling.

👤 Direct work with the founder, in a small team that already runs well.



Status: independent contractor. The salary is gross, and you handle your own taxes.



➤ A word from the founder

I am looking for someone with a brain, who takes responsibility. My goal is simple: within a few weeks, you are 100% autonomous. I don't double-check your work, because you handle it and I trust you. Every
 and every comment gets answered on time, every day. Nothing gets forgotten. If there is a problem, I hear about it from you first.

In return: your salary grows over time, you earn performance bonuses, and you take on more responsibility as the brand grows.



➤ How to apply

Apply through this form: 
/?k=KTwxdhhI5mc4OsXYEkEgFg&d=
If the link does not show, send us a message and we will send it to you.

Applications sent any other way will not be considered.



➤ Our hiring process

1. Application form

2. Quick video interview with the founder

3. You start. The first month is a paid trial, then it's a long-term role

title: AI Video Editor (Meta Ads, AI Video & Voice Tools) | US DTC Brand, Team Based in Southeast Asia | Full Time
description:
TYPE OF WORK: Full Time, Remote

WAGE / SALARY: $800 - $1,400 per month, based on skill, plus performance bonuses



➤ Who we are

We are a fast-growing DTC e-commerce brand, selling to women across the US. Our team is based in Southeast Asia (Bangkok time). Our growth engine is paid video ads on Meta, and we need one editor to own that production from end to end.

We are not the average brand that posts one ad a week. We test new video ads every day, and the editor is the engine of that machine.



➤ This is not a cutting job. It's a creative job.

We don't need someone who trims clips. We need someone who looks at any winning ad, understands why it works, and rebuilds the format for our product with AI tools, fast. We send a reference and a script, you find the recipe and deliver the finished ad.

And you own the result. You check your own work before we see it: the hands, the skin, the labels, the lip sync. Nothing fake ships.



➤ What you will make

1. B-roll ads with an AI voiceover (our daily format)

• We give you a validated script and a B-roll bank. You follow the script word for word, pick the shots, generate the voice, edit and caption.

2. Mixed ads

• Real B-roll plus AI B-roll, AI avatars, talking heads.

3. Full AI formats

• AI UGC, 3D and Pixar-style animation, skeleton ads, singing ads, drama ads.

4. New formats as they show up

• We send a reference, you find the recipe.



As the owner of video production, you will also:

• Build and maintain our B-roll bank and our library of proven formats.

• Suggest new formats and hooks when you see something work.

• Report what slows you down (assets, briefs, tools) to the founder, with a suggested fix.



Product accuracy is non-negotiable: every AI shot must look exactly like the real product.

We provide all the AI tools. You bring the skill, we bring the stack.



➤ Schedule

• Full time, 100% remote, long term.

• You can overlap 4 hours a day with Bangkok time (ICT). The rest of your hours are flexible.

• Fast, reliable internet: you upload heavy video files every day.

• Start: as soon as possible.



➤ Who you are

• Must have: 1+ year editing paid social video ads, vertical, for a DTC or e-commerce brand or an ad agency, with a portfolio to show for it. This is required.

• Must have: you use AI video and voice tools every day (Higgsfield, Veo, Kling, Seedance, ElevenLabs or similar), including full AI-generated ads from scratch. If you don't use them today, this role is not for you.

• You can look at any ad and rebuild the format.

• You catch what looks fake: hands, skin, labels, lip sync.

• You work fast and you don't need hand-holding.

• You read carefully. To prove it: in the application form, start your answer about your 3 best ads with the word banana.

• Bonus: you have written scripts or hooks yourself.



➤ Who we want

We're scaling hard right now. We want someone who is all in: full-time, with real hours to give, hungry to learn, and here to grow with us for the long run. This is a high-output role: what matters to us is the ads you ship, not hours on a timesheet. In return, the performance bonuses are serious.



➤ What's in it for you

💰 $800 - $1,400 per month, paid on time, every month. Strong skills get the top of the range.

📊 Performance bonuses on winning ads. They are serious.

🚀 A real growth path: lead editor when we hire more video editors, creative strategist if you have the eye for it.

🤝 A long-term, stable role with a brand that is actively scaling.

👤 Direct work with the founder.

🌴 100% remote, flexible hours outside the 4-hour overlap.



Status: independent contractor. The salary is gross, and you handle your own taxes.



➤ A word from the founder

I'm looking for someone with taste and ownership. My goal is simple: within a few weeks, I send you a reference and a script, and the ad comes back finished, without me fixing anything. You catch the fake hand before I do. In return: your salary grows with your results, you earn bonuses on winning ads, and you get more responsibility as the brand grows.



➤ How to apply

Apply through this form: form.asana.com/?k=RAQaZetSviBpIDNizVbAmw&d=1198498431751451

Applications sent any other way will not be considered. Please don't DM.



➤ Our hiring process

1. Application form, about 5 minutes plus a short Loom

2. Short paid test

3. Quick video call with the founder

4. You start. The first week is a paid trial week, then it's a long-term role

title: USA Inside Sales Specialist (Remote)
description:
Type: Full-Time (40 hrs/week — US Business Hours / Night Shift in PH)



Salary Range: $800 – $1,200 USD / month + Uncapped Closing & Demo Commissions



About 1P Algorithms (
)



1P Algorithms is an industry leader in automated futures trading and quantitative strategies. We build proprietary, AI-powered algorithms for active investors and prop firm traders—helping clients execute automated trades, run strategy setups on NinjaTrader/QuantVPS, and leverage advanced market insights without manual emotional stress. With 500+ active traders and over $50M+ in volume traded, we provide cutting-edge solutions backed by white-glove setup and support.



Role Overview



We are looking for a highly driven, ambitious, and persuasive Inside Sales Specialist to join our team full-time. In this role, you will own the full sales funnel—handling incoming web chats, making outbound phone calls, pushing hesitant prospects into demo bookings, following up with post-demo leads to close sales, and resurrecting dead conversations.

Note: This is a strict 100% full-time commitment aligned with USA business hours. We do not hire candidates working second jobs or freelance gigs on the side.  This is a long-term career with opportunities for advancement within the sales & marketing department and becoming a team lead.



Key Responsibilities



Full-Funnel Sales & Engagement: Drive prospects through every stage of the pipeline to final close.

Live Chat & Inbound Messaging: Monitor online website chat during US business hours to answer questions instantly and convert on-the-fence site visitors into booked demo appointments.



Outbound Telemarketing & Outreach: Perform outbound calls and follow-ups to prospective traders, cold leads, and prop firm traders.



Post-Demo Closing & Follow-Up: Stay in persistent contact with prospects who have completed a demo call, overcome lingering objections, and guide them to close.



Dead Lead Revival: Re-engage inactive leads and cold database contacts via phone,
, and chat to re-ignite buying interest.



Virtual Assistant & CRM Hygiene: Maintain accurate lead stages in the CRM, schedule appointments, and provide daily admin support.



Requirements & Qualifications



Experience: Minimum 5+ years of solid outbound telemarketing, inside sales, or appointment setting experience (preferably in FinTech, SaaS, Trading, Finance, or High-Ticket B2B/B2C).



Drive & Mindset: Fiercely self-motivated, goal-oriented, competitive, and resilient. You take pride in exceeding quotas and closing deals.



Schedule & Commitment: Must be able to work during US Business Hours (EST/PST / Philippines Night Shift). 



Communication: Near-native English fluency (written and spoken) with clear pronunciation and persuasive phone presence.



Tech Skills: Experience with CRMs (e.g., GoHighLevel, HubSpot, etc), web chat platforms (Intercom, Crisp), dialers, and Google Workspace. (Familiarity with NinjaTrader or futures/forex/stock trading is a strong bonus).



Home Setup: Dedicated quiet workspace, reliable high-speed internet (with backup connection), and a professional noise-canceling headset.



What We Offer



Competitive base salary ($800–$1,200 USD depending on experience).



Uncapped commission structure: Generous bonuses for both qualified demos set and deals closed.

Stable, long-term full-time remote career with growth opportunities.



Comprehensive onboarding and training on our trading algorithms and sales playbooks.



How to Apply



To demonstrate your attention to detail, please reply to this posting with:



A summary of your 5+ years of sales, phone outreach, and closing experience.



Optional:  A link to an audio recording (Vocaroo or Google Drive link) introducing yourself, stating any additional languages you speak, and explaining what drives you to succeed in international sales.

title: Creator Coordinator and Video Editor (Part-Time, Remote)
description:
About us



We are a growing e-commerce jewelry company based in Florida, local but shipping worldwide. We run on Shopify, Google Workspace, Notion and Slack.



The role



We are building a team of freelance video creators in the Philippines who film short jewelry videos for our
 and Instagram ads. You will run that team day to day. We start with 8 creators and about 16 videos a week, and plan to grow to 20 creators.



This role is both coordination and editing. Our marketing team writes the briefs, approves final videos, runs the ads and sends payments. You make sure everything reaches them on time and ready to use.



What you will do each week



Recruit and screen new creators, and run paid test videos

Post the weekly briefs on WhatsApp and answer creator questions

Keep creators on deadline: briefs go out Tuesday morning and videos are due Friday morning, Manila time

Check every video against our quality checklist and ask for one round of fixes when needed

Edit each approved video: trim, add captions, and cut two different openings

Keep our Notion tracker current: who filmed what, status and links

Prepare the weekly payment sheet for our team to approve



What success looks like



Every video arrives on time, or we know early when it will not

Most videos pass our review the first time

The tracker and payment sheet are right every week without reminders

Creators always know what is due and when



What we are looking for



Experience managing creators, a content team or a group of freelancers

Short vertical videos you edited yourself in CapCut or Premiere

Clear written English and polite, direct feedback

You track deadlines without being asked

Comfortable with WhatsApp, Google Drive and Notion

Experience with product videos for ads is a plus



Hours and pay



20 hours a week to start, with room to grow to 30

Flexible schedule, plus one 30-minute call a week between 7 and 9 AM US Central (9 to 11 PM Manila)

USD 6 to 10 an hour, based on experience

Paid weekly through Wise

Paid two-hour trial task before hiring, at USD 10 an hour



To apply



Start your reply with the word "paperclip" so we know you read this. Answer from your own experience and name the real company or account in each answer.



Tell us about a team of creators or freelancers you managed. How many people, and how did you track their work?

Share two short vertical videos you edited, and tell us what you changed in each.

A creator is two days late and not replying. What do you do?

What hours do you usually work, Manila time, and what hourly rate do you expect?



Optional: a two-minute video introducing yourself.

title: Lead Shopify Developer & Marketing Manager
description:
Company: 5Star Wireless Accessories & More LLC  

Brands: 5Star Wireless & Genie ISP  

Position Type: Full-time — 40 hours per week  

Reports To: Founder/CEO



Please apply here


/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdqKkyjmHocerNfcCQ7VqR6qNZxzGX-wDSkrPS2iCuneC64hw/viewform?usp=publish-editor



This is a full-time position requiring 40 hours per week. The starting rate is $3.75 USD per hour during the initial 90-day probationary period.



Upon successful completion of the probationary period and a satisfactory performance review, the rate will increase to $4.50 USD per hour. The review will assess Shopify development skills, marketing execution, quality of work, accountability, communication, leadership, and the ability to complete assignments independently and on schedule.



About the Role



We’re seeking a Lead Shopify Developer & Marketing Manager to lead ecommerce development, digital marketing, and business automation across our two brands: 5Star Wireless and Genie ISP.



This is a hands-on leadership position for someone who can build, create, manage, and deliver. You should be comfortable developing custom Shopify functionality, producing compelling marketing content, connecting platforms through APIs, and turning business ideas into dependable systems.



You will oversee an Ecommerce Coordinator responsible for daily store maintenance, product listings, page updates, and other ecommerce assignments. Your responsibility is to establish priorities, provide direction, review completed work, and handle advanced technical development and marketing initiatives.



Marketing is an ongoing responsibility of this position. During major development projects, your focus may shift toward coding and implementation. Between those projects, your primary focus will be marketing campaigns, short-form video production, customer acquisition, store performance, and developing useful business systems.



We need someone who takes ownership, thinks independently, communicates clearly, and follows through without constant supervision.



Schedule & Availability



This position requires a consistent commitment of 40 hours per week, with an agreed working schedule and availability for team meetings, collaboration, and timely communication.



Working hours must be dedicated to assigned company responsibilities. Other professional commitments must not interfere with your agreed schedule, availability, performance, or deadlines.



You are expected to communicate promptly when blocked, request direction when priorities are unclear, and identify useful next steps when assignments are completed.



Key Responsibilities



Shopify Development & Store Optimization



- Lead technical development and improvements across both Shopify stores.

- Develop and customize Shopify themes using Liquid, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Shopify theme architecture.

- Build reusable sections, templates, and features that support merchandising and marketing campaigns.

- Improve mobile usability, navigation, product discovery, page performance, and the overall shopping experience.

- Review website changes completed by the Ecommerce Coordinator and make technical, visual, and functional refinements.

- Diagnose and resolve theme issues, app conflicts, broken functionality, and integration problems.

- Evaluate existing apps and recommend when to configure an available solution versus developing something custom.

- Implement improvements that help customers understand our products, complete purchases, and access support.

- Test changes before release and maintain a practical rollback process.



Custom Apps, APIs & Business Systems



- Develop and maintain custom Shopify apps, internal tools, and integrations.

- Work with Shopify APIs, GraphQL, webhooks, authentication, and third-party services.

- Build workflows that connect ecommerce, customer records, communications, and other business platforms.

- Help develop a lease-to-own platform, including customer-facing pages, application workflows, customer portals, and supporting integrations.

- Translate business requirements into clear technical plans, milestones, and working solutions.

- Develop backend services and databases where needed.

- Maintain existing systems, troubleshoot failures, and improve reliability over time.



AI & Customer Follow-Up Automation



- Build and improve automated customer follow-up workflows.

- Develop or integrate AI calling agents for approved uses such as inquiries, appointment reminders, lead follow-up, and customer service.

- Connect calling and messaging systems with relevant customer records and business tools.

- Include appropriate consent handling, opt-out controls, human handoffs, and activity records.

- Identify repetitive work that can be simplified through automation.

- Evaluate AI tools based on their practical usefulness, reliability, and cost.

- Document workflows so other team members can operate and maintain them.



Digital Marketing & Campaign Execution



- Plan and execute marketing initiatives for both brands.

- Develop campaigns around products, services, promotions, and customer needs.

- Create landing pages and supporting customer journeys.

- Coordinate
, SMS, social media, and paid advertising initiatives as appropriate.

- Develop campaign messaging, offers, calls to action, and creative concepts.

- Monitor campaign performance and recommend improvements based on results.

- Test different messages, creative assets, and page experiences.

- Keep marketing activity moving consistently between technical projects.



Short-Form Video & Creative Content



- Personally create and edit engaging short-form videos for platforms such as TikTok, Instagram Reels,
, and YouTube Shorts.

- Develop strong hooks, scripts, captions, product demonstrations, and promotional concepts.

- Use sound judgment about pacing, visual presentation, branding, and audience relevance.

- Produce content with a clear purpose and call to action.

- Use AI-assisted creative tools where they improve quality or efficiency.

- Maintain accuracy in product claims, pricing, offers, and service descriptions.

- Coordinate supporting content assignments with the Ecommerce Coordinator.



Ecommerce Leadership & Accountability



- Oversee the Ecommerce Coordinator’s assignments and priorities.

- Set clear expectations, deadlines, and acceptance criteria.

- Review work for accuracy, functionality, presentation, and alignment with business goals.

- Provide constructive feedback and ensure necessary corrections are completed.

- Maintain a clear project backlog covering both stores, marketing initiatives, and development work.

- Communicate progress, blockers, risks, and recommendations to ownership.

- Raise questions early when requirements are unclear.

- Take responsibility for completing projects and verifying that finished work functions as intended.



Required Qualifications



Shopify & Development Experience



- Demonstrated experience developing and maintaining Shopify stores beyond basic theme-editor changes.

- Strong working knowledge of Shopify Liquid, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

- Experience working with Shopify themes, sections, templates, metafields, and app integrations.

- Experience developing custom Shopify apps and API integrations.

- Familiarity with GraphQL, REST APIs, webhooks, and secure authentication.

- Full-stack development experience, including a backend language or framework such as Node.js, Python, or an equivalent.

- Experience with databases, application hosting, deployment, and troubleshooting.

- Experience using Git or another version-control system.

- Ability to test changes, investigate errors, and maintain working production systems.



Marketing & Creative Experience



- Demonstrated experience planning and executing digital marketing campaigns.

- A portfolio of short-form marketing videos you personally created or edited.

- Strong written communication and customer-facing copywriting skills.

- An eye for design, layout, branding, and customer experience.

- Ability to interpret marketing and ecommerce performance data and turn findings into practical actions.



Leadership & Work Habits



- Experience coordinating projects or directing another team member’s work.

- Strong organization, prioritization, and follow-through.

- Ability to work independently while keeping management informed.

- Confidence to recommend a better approach and explain your reasoning respectfully.

- Willingness to accept feedback and take responsibility for mistakes.

- Careful handling of customer information, credentials, and company assets.

- Ability to provide realistic estimates and communicate promptly when a deadline is at risk.

- Availability to consistently fulfill the 40-hour weekly commitment.



Preferred Experience



- TypeScript and React.

- Shopify Functions, customer account extensions, or other Shopify extensions.

- AI voice agents, telephony integrations, and CRM automation.

- Automation tools such as n8n, Make, or Zapier.

-
 and SMS marketing platforms such as Klaviyo.

- Paid social advertising and creative testing.

- SEO, analytics, conversion tracking, and conversion optimization.

- Customer portals, subscription platforms, or lease-to-own systems.

- Mobile application development using React Native, Flutter, or similar technologies.

- Experience supporting multiple brands or stores.



What Success Looks Like



- Both Shopify stores are dependable, easy to use, and consistently improving.

- Ecommerce assignments have clear owners, deadlines, and quality standards.

- Technical projects move from planning to tested implementation.

- Marketing campaigns and short-form content are produced consistently.

- Performance reporting connects activity to meaningful outcomes, such as qualified leads, purchases, conversion, and customer engagement.

- Automations reduce manual work and include a clear process for handling errors.

- Code, documentation, and system access remain accessible to the company.

- Ownership receives timely updates without needing to repeatedly request progress.



How to Apply



Please submit:



1. Your résumé and a brief introduction explaining why you fit this combined development, marketing, and leadership role.

2. Shopify examples, describing the code or functionality you personally developed.

3. A custom app, API integration, or automation example, explaining the business problem and your contribution.

4. Two or three short-form marketing videos you personally created or edited.

5. A marketing campaign example, including your responsibilities and results where available.

6. Your availability, preferred working schedule, other ongoing commitments, and compensation expectations.



If previous work is confidential, you may provide a redacted case study, demonstration, or walkthrough instead of sharing private code or customer information.



Please distinguish work you personally completed from work completed by a team.



Shortlisted candidates may be invited to participate in a technical discussion, portfolio walkthrough, and a paid practical assessment.



We’re looking for someone who can take an idea, develop a practical plan, build the solution, and help market it successfully.

title: Customer Success Operations Manager (Talent, Training and Workforce Operations) - ₱128,000-₱160,000 p/m + Bonuses
description:
Independent Contractor | Long-Term Leadership Role



Once hired, you'll work as an independent contractor (and receive an independent contractor agreement).



Pay:

- Starting base: PHP 128,000 per month, depending on approved experience level

- Full base: PHP 160,000 per month plus performance-based bonuses, once certification requirements are met



Payment: Monthly (or twice a month if preferred) via Wise. Always on time.



This is not a short-term job.

We build long-term leadership inside the company.



You'll make sure our Client Success team has the right people, trained well and doing great work. You'll work directly with leadership to improve how we hire, train, and manage the team.



ABOUT US



Young Publisher: 



We are an international digital marketing company working with content creators and online brands. The company has over 85 team members around the world. We've been in the industry since 2019. We're currently serving over 1,000+ high-ticket clients per year.



We provide an 80% done-for-you content and monetization system that helps creators grow, go viral, and turn views into income using short-form content, AI tools, and proven strategies. Our clients are typically beginners or early-stage creators looking to build their brand, gain followers, and generate income online.



We focus on accountability, long-term growth, and real client results.





WHAT WE OFFER



- Independent contractor role

- Monday to Friday schedule: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours per week

- Payment: Monthly (or twice a month if preferred) via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear pay progression

- High-growth environment where you'll be a core part of the company's growth

- Real ownership: you will directly shape how we deliver for clients

- Tight-knit leadership team that moves fast and values initiative

- Clear path to senior leadership or director level

- Full work-from-home flexibility

- Access to paid AI tools and systems

- Strong company culture



TASKS



Recruiting, Hiring & Headcount Planning

- Plan hiring needs by reviewing team capacity, client volume, turnover risk, and ramp time, so hiring starts before service levels drop.

- Run the hiring pipeline with Recruiting and keep strong candidates moving through CV, Loom, test task, interview, and roleplay stages.

- Assess candidates on judgment, ownership, process discipline, coachability, client communication, reliability, and schedule fit.

- Keep a ready bench of qualified backup candidates for upcoming hiring needs.

- Track candidate volume, quality, conversion, hires, and early new-hire failures to keep improving hiring standards.



New-Hire Onboarding, Training & Ramp

- Make sure new hires have Hubstaff, Slack, Airtable, modules, documents, calendars, tools, hardware, work schedule, and time-zone setup ready before training starts.

- Manage training curriculum, quizzes, exams, tasks, progress, deadlines, and roleplay or certification steps before new hires work independently.

- Spot slow or weak trainees early and turn repeated gaps into retraining, SOPs, templates, checklists, and training resources.



Workforce Operations & Talent Management

- Monitor schedules, Hubstaff, time off, absences, time-zone coverage, utilization, backup coverage, and headcount needs to catch staffing risks early.

- Coordinate retraining, warnings, performance improvement plans, and monthly talent reviews, with clear recommendations backed by evidence.

- Keep hiring, onboarding, and workforce data accurate, and turn repeated people problems into permanent fixes.



You own outcomes here. We expect you to take charge, solve problems, and keep systems running smoothly.



REQUIREMENTS



- 2+ years in CS Operations, People Operations, Recruiting, Training/L&D, Workforce Operations, or Team Management (high-ticket coaching, online education, SaaS, BPO, or another fast-moving remote business).

- Proven track record recruiting, interviewing, hiring, onboarding, training, or ramping customer-facing team members at volume.

- Strong skills in Airtable/CRMs, Google Sheets, hiring or training trackers, workforce reporting, and data validation.

- Experience building structured hiring and training systems using scorecards, test tasks, interviews, roleplays, certification standards, and clear pass/fail criteria.

- Proven ability to turn hiring, onboarding, reliability, or performance problems into clear SOPs, training, and accountability processes.



OPTIONAL BUT PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



- Hiring or training CSMs, account managers, coaches, support staff, or other client-facing roles in a high-ticket or service-based business

- Hubstaff, Airtable, remote workforce management, hiring automation, or AI-assisted recruiting and training

We are not looking for someone who simply cuts footage, adds captions and follows instructions. We want someone who can produce exceptional, professional-quality videos, contribute creative ideas and eventually take ownership of our video production operations across multiple clients and businesses.



**Our number one priority is your ability to produce high-quality, engaging social media advertising videos that generate enquiries, leads and sales.**



### Primary Responsibilities – Video Editing & Production



- Produce high-quality video advertisements for
, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube.

- Create engaging short-form videos with strong opening hooks, effective storytelling and clear calls to action.

- Develop creative advertising concepts, scripts and storyboards.

- Produce professional motion graphics, animations, transitions, typography and captions.

- Deliver high-quality colour grading, sound design and audio mixing.

- Source and incorporate relevant stock footage, music and other creative assets.

- Transform raw client footage into polished, professional advertising content.

- Create multiple advertising variations for creative testing.

- Repurpose long-form video content into engaging short-form content.

- Maintain exceptional attention to detail and consistent production quality.

- Understand professional video export settings, resolution, frame rates, codecs and aspect ratios.



### Social Media Advertising & Digital Marketing



Ideally, the successful applicant will also have experience in:



- Setting up and managing
 and Instagram advertising campaigns through Meta Ads Manager.

- Installing and configuring Meta Pixels and conversion tracking.

- Creating custom audiences, lookalike audiences and retargeting campaigns.

- Testing different advertising creatives, audiences and campaign strategies.

- Monitoring and optimising advertising performance.

- Understanding advertising metrics, including CTR, CPC, CPA, CPL and ROAS.

- Researching competitors and successful advertising campaigns.

- Managing and scheduling organic social media content.

- Understanding customer psychology, pain points, offers and direct-response advertising.



We want someone who understands the difference between a video that looks good and a video that actually generates results.



### Video Production & Coordination



As the role develops, we would like you to take on additional responsibilities, including:



- Planning and coordinating video production across multiple clients.

- Developing creative concepts, scripts, storyboards and shot lists.

- Communicating filming requirements to clients.

- Coordinating the collection and organisation of raw footage.

- Managing production schedules, deadlines, feedback and revisions.

- Developing efficient video production processes.

- Identifying new content and advertising opportunities independently.

- Using AI tools and automation to improve production efficiency without compromising quality.



There is an opportunity for the right person to grow into a senior video producer or creative production management position.



### Essential Requirements



- A strong professional video editing portfolio.

- Demonstrated experience producing high-quality social media advertising videos.

- Proficiency in professional video editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro or equivalent.

- Strong creative and visual storytelling abilities.

- Excellent attention to detail.

- Strong written and spoken English.

- Ability to work independently, investigate problems and find solutions.

- Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.

- Ability to follow detailed instructions and respond constructively to feedback.

- A genuine interest in developing a long-term working relationship.



### Additional Skills That Will Be Highly Regarded



- Meta Ads campaign management.

- Pixel installation and conversion tracking.

- Advertising copywriting and scriptwriting.

- Motion graphics and advanced animation.

- AI-assisted video production.

- Basic SEO and YouTube SEO.

- WordPress and website content management.

- Previous digital marketing agency experience.

- Experience coordinating other editors, videographers or creative team members.



Not having every additional skill will not disqualify you. Exceptional video editing and advertising creative ability are our highest priorities.

title: AI Greeting Card Designer (ChatGPT Image Generation) – Remote
description:
Rate: $3–$4 USD per hour, depending on experience

Type: Remote | Part-time / Full-time



About Us

We're a UK-based online business selling personalised greeting cards for every occasion, from birthdays and anniversaries to new babies, weddings, sympathy and graduation. Our cards are warm, playful and often funny. We're growing our range and need creative people to help produce new photo-style card designs.



The Role

You'll use ChatGPT's image generation to create high-quality, photo-realistic greeting card designs for our catalogue, then refine them so they're ready to print.



Responsibilities



Generate photo-style greeting card images using ChatGPT based on briefs (occasion, theme, tone)

Write and refine prompts to get consistent, on-brand results

Create designs for a range of occasions: birthdays (including milestone ages), anniversaries, weddings, new baby, get well soon, sympathy, seasonal and humorous cards

Check every image for quality issues (distorted hands or faces, garbled text, odd details) and regenerate when needed

Make sure designs suit a UK audience (British spelling, humour and occasions)

Organise and deliver files with clear naming in the required sizes and formats

Hit daily or weekly design targets



Requirements



Hands-on experience with ChatGPT image generation (or Midjourney, DALL·E, etc.)

A good eye for design, composition and colour

Strong written English and a sense of humour

Understanding of copyright: no celebrities, brand logos or copyrighted characters

Reliable internet connection

Able to work independently and meet deadlines



Nice to Have



Experience with Canva, Photoshop or other editing tools

Greeting card, print or e-commerce design experience

Familiarity with UK culture and card-giving occasions



What We Offer



ChatGPT Plus account provided, so you don't need your own subscription

Fully remote work



How to Apply

Send us:



A short intro about yourself and your AI image experience

3–5 samples of AI-generated images you've made (a portfolio link is fine)

Your availability (hours per week)



Test task: Create one photo-style birthday card design for a 30th birthday with a light, funny tone, and include the prompt you used.



Applications without samples won't be considered.

title: Online English/World History Teachers (Near-Native Accent)

About Pomelo Academy

Pomelo Academy is an innovative online international school dedicated to delivering high-quality education to students worldwide. We provide a dynamic and engaging learning environment, catering to individualized instruction that transcends geographical boundaries.





Job Description

We are seeking passionate and experienced Near-Native English-speaking Online K-12 English and/or World History Teachers. The ideal candidates will have solid academic backgrounds in English and History, experience teaching young learners, and a commitment to creating a supportive and engaging online learning environment.





Responsibilities

Provide intensive English and/or World History instruction to individuals and small groups of 2–6 students aged 5–18.

Utilize international-standard curriculums.

Create and deliver engaging lesson plans tailored to each student’s needs.

Monitor and assess student progress, providing regular feedback to students and parents.

Foster a positive and encouraging learning environment.

Professional teacher with at least 2 years of teaching experience (Kindergarten–Grade 12).

Must hold a valid teaching license/certification.

Near-native accent in English.

Strong academic background in English and/or World History.

Ability to work between 17:00–22:00 (Weekdays) and 9:00–22:00 (Weekends), GMT+8.

Experience teaching in public/international schools or online classes.

Experience working with young learners aged 5–18.

Familiarity with ClassIn and digital literacy (Microsoft Suite and other educational platforms).

Must have a stable and fast internet connection and a PC/laptop with at least Windows 10/Mac OS Catalina.





Benefits

Work with an international team of educators.

Professional development and training opportunities.

Regular enrollment basis is observed, not a booking system, ensuring a stable and consistent teaching schedule.

title: Part-Time AWS Engineer, Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore (Required)
description:
Hours: About 20 hrs/week, remote



We're a small US company building AI agents on AWS. We need a hands-on engineer who has already shipped work on Amazon Bedrock and Bedrock AgentCore. This is not a learning role.



Must have (you'll be screened on these):

- Real Bedrock AgentCore experience with Runtime, Gateway, Memory, or Identity. Tell us which parts you used and what you built.

- Amazon Bedrock model access, quotas, and cost control in a real AWS account

- IAM least-privilege: scoped execution roles and condition keys

- Terraform or CDK for AWS infrastructure



Nice to have:

- Bedrock Knowledge Bases, Bedrock Agents, or Strands Agents

- Multi-tenant data isolation

- CloudWatch monitoring and alarms



How we work:

- An NDA and IP assignment get signed before any project details are shared.

- All work happens in a staging environment. Nothing reaches production without owner approval.



To apply, answer these in your message:

1. Describe one AgentCore deployment you built. Which parts did you use, which model, and how did you scope the execution role?

2. How would you keep each customer's agent memory and data separate?

3. If you've used Terraform or CDK for Bedrock or AgentCore, what gaps did you hit and how did you work around them?



Applications without specific answers to these won't be considered.

title: Customer Success Manager | Shopify
description:
IMPORTANT — PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING:

We are only reviewing applications from candidates with at least 2 years of direct experience as a Customer Success Manager, Account Manager, or Retention Manager within a SaaS, e-commerce, CMS, or web-based tech company.   Please do not apply if your background is strictly in general customer service, BPO voice/chat support, or virtual assistance—those applications will be automatically filtered out.





About the Role

We’re looking for a sharp, detail-oriented Customer Success Manager to join our fast-moving startup. You’ll lead customer onboarding, partner with a portfolio of ambitious Shopify brands, and help them drive measurable outcomes from our platform.



This is a strong fit for someone with customer success experience, familiarity with CRO, and a background in Shopify who thrives when things move quickly.



You’ll partner directly with innovative, leading Shopify merchants as part of a lean, high-ownership team where initiative and real impact matter and where your work visibly moves the needle.



What You Get

• Above-market base salary

• Fully remote, long-term role—no commute, no office mandate

• Room to grow into senior roles over time

Job Requirements

Experience

Skills & Competencies

Communication

Setup & Availability

Job Responsibilities

To ensure that you have reviewed this post, kindly send a message with the subject line: CS - [Applicant Name]. Attach or link your CV, make sure it can be viewed by everyone. Provide 2-3 sentences why you want to take on this Customer Success Manager role.

title: Construction Project Coordinator – US General Contractor (Remote, Full-Time, US Eastern Hours)
description:
Construction Project Coordinator – US General Contractor (Remote, Full-Time, US Eastern Hours)



ABOUT US

Northrose Construction is a New York–based interior contractor. We build out and refresh stores overnight for national retail and restaurant brands across New York and New Jersey, including Sephora and Shake Shack. We're growing fast and need an experienced construction coordinator to run our back office, build our subcontractor network, and keep every project organized so our field team can focus on building.



THIS ROLE IS ONLY FOR YOU IF ALL OF THESE ARE TRUE

- 3–5+ years working as a project coordinator, project administrator, or estimating/admin assistant for a US-based construction company (general contractor or subcontractor)

- Commercial construction experience (retail, restaurant, office, or healthcare interiors). Residential-only or real estate VA experience is not enough

- You have personally handled change orders, subcontractor COIs, invoicing/progress billing, and project schedules

- You're confident making phone calls to US contractors, suppliers, and clients

- You use AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT every day to work faster: drafting
s, summarizing drawings and documents, building trackers and reports. You always double-check what AI produces before it goes out

- Excellent written and spoken English. Our clients and subcontractors deal with you directly

- This will be your ONLY full-time job, and you can work 9 AM–5 PM US Eastern, Monday–Friday

- Reliable internet plus a backup (power bank/generator and mobile data)



Please do not apply if you are a general virtual assistant without construction experience. We will not review those applications.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Project coordination

- Manage our project inboxes (bids, billing, compliance): handle routine requests and flag what needs the owner's decision

- Turn nightly site photos and crew updates into clean daily reports for clients

- Log every change order with photos, quantities and pricing, and draft change order documents for approval

- Coordinate schedules and confirmations with subcontractors and crews

- Keep project files, task boards and trackers organized and current

- Manage the owner's calendar: site walks, subcontractor meetings, and client calls



Subcontractor sourcing and management

- Find new subcontractors by trade (tile, carpentry, painting, plumbing, electrical, HVAC, general labor, cleaning) using Google, union contractor lists, NYC license lookups, BuildingConnected/ConstructConnect, and trade groups

- Call and
 contractors, introduce Northrose, and guide them through our subcontractor application

- Pre-screen subcontractors: verify insurance (GL and workers' comp), licenses, crew size, supervision, night availability, and references

- Build and maintain our vetted subcontractor database with rates, coverage areas, and insurance expiration dates

- Send scopes and bid invitations, follow up on quotes, and prepare side-by-side quote comparisons

- Collect and verify subcontractor COIs and onboarding documents before anyone goes on site



Bids, purchasing and billing

- Track incoming bid invitations and deadlines, and prepare bid packages so nothing is missed

- Request supplier quotes, place material orders after approval, and track deliveries

- Prepare and send invoices, track payments, and follow up on POs and outstanding balances

- Track job costs for each project (labor, subcontractors, materials, dumpsters, transportation, meals)

- Enter expenses and invoices into QuickBooks for our accountant (data entry only)



Compliance and growth

- Track insurance and license renewals, and request certificates from our broker for new clients

- Register Northrose with new clients' vendor portals and complete onboarding paperwork

- Turn project photos into LinkedIn and Instagram posts, and keep our Google Business Profile and website project pages updated

- Help hire field staff: post jobs, screen applicants, and schedule interviews

- Use AI tools to speed up reports, scopes,
s and document reviews, and help us build better workflows over time



NICE TO HAVE

- Plan reading, quantity takeoffs, or estimating support

- Experience sourcing and vetting subcontractors or managing a vendor database

- QuickBooks, Procore, BuildingConnected, Notion, or similar tools



PAY & GROWTH

- $1,100–$1,300 USD/month depending on experience

- Paid 1-week trial

- Long-term, stable role with a performance review and raise opportunity after 90 days

- Room to grow into estimating and assistant project management as we expand



HOW TO APPLY (all 4 steps required)

1. Use the subject line "NIGHT SHIFT BUILDER"

2. List the US construction companies you've worked for, your title at each, and the dates

3. Answer these questions in your own words:

   a) A subcontractor's COI expires tomorrow and they're scheduled on site tonight. What exactly do you check on a COI, and what do you do?

   b) Our bid priced 350 SF of ceiling tile replacement at $5,900. The client asked us to replace 950 SF. What is the change order amount? Show your math.

   c) What is the difference between a change order and a change directive?

   d) Describe one real task where you used Claude or ChatGPT in construction admin work. What did you ask it, and what did you fix or double-check in its answer?

   e) We need a union tile crew in New York City that can work nights, starting next week. Walk us through exactly how you would find and vet one.

4. Send a 2-minute video (Loom or similar) introducing yourself and walking us through one construction project you supported



Incomplete applications will not be reviewed.

title: Part-Time Contract | Remote Teaching | Help Shape the Next Generation of Business Support Professionals
description:
Hi! I'm Yas, HR of HIDARI Group, a Canadian business optimization and implementation company.

HIDARI helps service-based business owners fix their operations, systems, marketing and growth. We don't stop at strategy. We help make it work in the business.

HIDARI Academy is where we train the people who make that possible. Our first program, the Independent Business Support Professional Pilot, is a 10-week course that turns aspiring and early-career virtual assistants into professionals business owners can trust. Students work through real owner situations, case labs, a business simulation and a final capstone, then launch their own careers.

The course is built. I'm looking for an instructor who can bring it to life: someone who leads students through it, gives them feedback that helps them grow and keeps them going until the end.



The Kind of Person I'm Looking For

This role is for someone who loves the moment a learner finally gets it.

You've taught before, in person, online or both, and you know that good teaching is more than delivering content. It's reading the room (even on Zoom), noticing who's falling behind and giving feedback that's honest without being discouraging.

You're the kind of instructor who says:

"Three students got this wrong the same way. Let's look at why."



Your Core Responsibilities

- Teaching

- Lead live online sessions, such as weekly classes, Q&As and cohort calls, on Zoom or Google Meet

- Explain lessons, walk through case labs and model what good work looks like

- Keep sessions interactive with questions, breakout activities and real examples

- Record short explainers or session recaps when needed



Grading and feedback

- Review and grade assignments, case labs and the capstone using our rubric and answer keys

- Give specific, kind and honest written feedback within the agreed turnaround

- Mark Knowledge Checks and the Final Exam, and flag anything that looks off



Student support

- Answer student questions in our group chat or by

- Check in with students who fall behind and help them get back on track

- Keep learners motivated through all 10 weeks



Course feedback

- Share what you see: where students struggle, which lessons land and what's confusing

- Work with our course developer so each cohort runs better than the last



As You Grow

- The right person can grow into:

- Leading cohorts on your own from start to finish

- Teaching new courses and workshops as the Academy grows

- Training and mentoring new instructors

- Helping shape the curriculum



Requirements

- Teaching experience, in person, online or both. This could be classroom teaching, corporate training, tutoring, coaching, ESL teaching or running workshops. Please tell us where and how long you taught.

- Comfort teaching online. You can run a live class over Zoom or Google Meet, share your screen and keep people engaged.

- Excellent spoken and written English. You explain things clearly and simply.

- A reliable remote setup:

Stable, fast internet, plus a backup option such as mobile data or a power bank

- A computer with a working webcam and microphone (a headset is a plus)

- A quiet, well-lit space where you can teach without interruptions

- Availability for live sessions that overlap with our students' schedules. Times will be agreed before each cohort.

Comfort with Google Workspace (Forms, Sheets, Docs) and basic tools such as Loom



Bonus:

- You've worked as a virtual assistant or in business operations. You'll understand our students' world from the inside.

- Experience teaching adults or career-change learners

- Experience with Google Classroom, Teachable, Kajabi, Thinkific or similar

- Experience running cohort-based or community-driven programs

- A TESOL, TEFL, LET or training certification



The Traits That Matter Most

- Empathy for beginners. You remember what it felt like not to know.

- Patience. You can answer the same question for the fifth time like it's the first.

- Warmth and presence. Students feel encouraged, even through a screen.

- Fairness. You grade consistently and explain why.

- Reliability. You show up on time, every time, and return feedback when you said you would.

- Openness to feedback. You're always looking for ways to teach better.



What Success Looks Like in Your First 90 Days

- You know the course inside out. You've reviewed all four stages and the answer keys, and can teach any week confidently.

- Sessions run smoothly. Classes start on time, stay engaging and end with students knowing what to do next.

- Feedback arrives on time. Assignments are graded within the agreed turnaround, with comments students can act on.

- Students stay. Fewer students drop out, and those who struggle get help early.

- Students rate you well. Feedback scores for teaching and support are strong.

- You help improve the course. You've shared clear, specific notes on what to fix after each stage.



Teaching Exercise

Please send me:

1. Short Teaching Video (2-3 minutes) Record yourself teaching one skill a new virtual assistant needs, as if you were teaching it live to a class, for example how to write a clear end-of-day report to a client. Loom, Zoom or your phone is fine. I'm looking for clarity, warmth and how you engage learners, not production value.

2. Feedback Sample Here's a student's end-of-day report:

"Hi! Today I did some
s and worked on the spreadsheet. Also had a problem with the calendar thing but I think it's ok now. Tomorrow I'll continue. Thanks!"

Write the feedback you'd give this student in 5–8 sentences.

Please don't spend hours on this. I'm looking for how you teach and how you help someone improve.



Our Hiring Process

- Application. Send your application, teaching video and feedback sample.

- Short call. Shortlisted applicants will be invited to a 20–30 minute video call. We'll also check your setup.

- Paid trial. Finalists teach a short paid demo session or grade sample student work from the course.

Offer. The best fit receives a contractor offer and onboarding.



What It's Like Working With Me

I move quickly, I have a lot of ideas, and I enjoy working with people who are comfortable contributing their own.

See a lesson that isn't landing? Tell me. Have a better way to explain something? Try it, then share what worked. Students struggling? Help me understand why and figure out a better approach.

HIDARI Academy is still early, which means our first instructors will shape what it becomes. As the Academy grows, I want the people who helped build it to grow with it.



Start your application with "Lighthouse" and tell me what you can bring to HIDARI Academy.

title: Sales Specialist
description:
Sales, Lead Generation & Enrollment Specialist | Remote Dance Studio Sales



If you’ve ever spotted a way to bring in customers and thought, “I’d love to be the one who runs with that,” you’ll have that opportunity here.



Your job is to figure out where our next students will come from and make the first move. You might get a local organization to introduce the studio to its families, start a conversation with a parent who’s looking for classes, or discover a referral source we’ve overlooked. The owner knows the studio and its students. You bring the outreach experience to turn that knowledge into a steady flow of interested families.



WHAT YOU’LL OWN



- Generate new leads. This is your main responsibility. Choose promising outreach channels, build referral relationships, and start conversations. Track which efforts bring interested families to the studio so you know where to invest your time.

- Turn interest into enrollment. About 98% of our students are kids, so most of your conversations will be with parents. We offer adult classes too. Respond promptly to inquiries during your shifts, learn what each person is looking for, and recommend a class they’ll feel confident signing up for.

- Own the follow up. Use calls, texts, and
s to keep conversations moving. Keep the CRM current and give the owner a brief daily update on new leads, bookings, enrollments, and next steps.

- Support the studio with a weekly
 to leads, occasional social media content, and light VA tasks. Sales and outreach come first.



WHAT YOU’LL BRING



Previous sales experience is required, including experience finding your own prospects. We’ll introduce you to our classes and the families we serve. From there, you’ll d
 who to reach, what to say, and what to change when an approach gets few replies.



Strong phone skills matter here. You can put a parent at ease, ask a thoughtful question, listen to the answer, and confidently invite them to enroll. You’ll need C1 level or higher spoken and written English.



We value someone we can count on. When you tell a parent you’ll call on Thursday, you make the call. When an outreach idea shows promise, you take the next step without waiting for a reminder. Previous VA experience is preferred. CRM familiarity and an interest in dance are both welcome.



PAID TRIAL, BASE PAY, AND BONUSES



The role begins with a 2 week paid trial at 20 hours per week. You’ll receive $125 USD total for 40 hours. We’ll agree on your trial shifts in advance.



During the trial, we’ll assess your initiative, lead generation, sales ability, and reliability. We’ll look at the prospects you find independently, the conversations your outreach starts, which ones progress toward bookings or paid enrollments, and how consistently you follow through.



Candidates who demonstrate exceptional performance during the trial may transition to the regular 34-hour engagement ahead of schedule.



At the end of the trial, we’ll review the results together. If we both d
 to continue, you’ll move to 34 hours per week with a base salary of $450 USD per month, paid every 2 weeks through Wise.



You can earn performance bonuses on top of your base pay when your outreach consistently brings in multiple new paying students per month.



REGULAR SCHEDULE



All times are US Pacific Time.



Monday through Friday: 10 am to 2 pm and 4 pm to 6 pm, with a break from 2 pm to 4 pm.

Saturday and Sunday: 10 am to noon each day.



That’s 34 hours across 7 days. Both weekend shifts are required. We’re looking for someone who wants this to be their primary long term role and can reliably cover each shift. Hours may change seasonally within the studio’s 8 am to 9 pm Pacific window. We’ll discuss and agree on any changes in advance.



HOW TO APPLY



Include “Silver Slippers” in your subject line or message title. Send your resume, confirm you can work the full regular schedule, and answer this question in a few sentences:



Tell us about one sales opportunity you created from scratch. How did you find it, what did you personally do to move it forward, and what was the outcome?

title: Client Success & Marketing Operations Manager
description:
ABOUT REVIEWFY



Reviewfy is an Australian marketing and automation agency. We help local service businesses (trades, automotive and home services) get more reviews, more leads and more repeat customers. We do this with review automation, missed-call text-back, lead pipelines, referral and reactivation campaigns and Meta ads, all built on GoHighLevel.



We're growing, and we're hiring our first dedicated Client Success Manager: the person our clients know, trust and speak with every week.





PLEASE NOTE: THIS IS A CUSTOMER-FACING ROLE



Roughly 70% of the job is talking to Australian business owners by phone, SMS and
. The other 30% is marketing operations. If you prefer back-office work with little client contact, this role is not for you. If you enjoy building relationships, keeping projects moving and getting answers from busy people, read on.





WHAT YOU'LL DO



Client communication

• Be the main point of contact for a portfolio of Australian clients

• Make regular phone calls: onboarding kick-offs, check-ins, follow-ups and monthly results walkthroughs

• Respond to clients quickly and professionally, and escalate technical issues with clear notes



Onboarding & chasing missing assets

• Take new clients from "signed" to "live" using our onboarding checklist

• Follow up until missing assets and access arrive: logos, photos, offers, website domain access, Google Business Profile access, review links,
 Page and ad account access, phone numbers and customer lists

• Keep each client's status up to date so nobody gets stuck in "waiting for assets"



Marketing operations

• Set up and check client accounts in GoHighLevel from our templates (training provided)

• Coordinate campaign launches (review requests, reactivation, referrals, Meta ads) with the team

• Prepare and check monthly client reports before they go out

• Spot problems early (broken forms, no new leads, low review rates) and flag opportunities to improve or upsell



Processes

• Turn what works into SOPs and checklists

• Help us improve onboarding and client delivery as we scale





WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Must have

• Excellent spoken and written English, with clear, easy-to-understand pronunciation and confidence on the phone with native English speakers

• Comfortable understanding Australian accents, slang and fast-paced conversations (many of our clients call from job sites)

• 2+ years in a client-facing role (client success, account management, customer service or project coordination), ideally at an agency or with AU/US/UK clients

• Organised and persistent: you follow up without being reminded

• A solid grasp of digital marketing basics: Google reviews, Google Business Profile,
/Instagram ads, landing pages, CRM and SMS/email automation

• Quick to learn new software

• Reliable internet with a backup connection and power, a quiet workspace and a noise-cancelling headset



Nice to have

• GoHighLevel experience (strongly preferred)

• Previous experience speaking regularly with Australian clients

• Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, Google Workspace

• Experience working with trades or other local service businesses





SALARY, SCHEDULE & GROWTH



• Salary: USD 1,000 per month during the first three months, then USD 1,200 per month from month four.

• Schedule: Monday to Friday, Australian business hours (about 6:00/7:00 AM – 2:00/3:00 PM Philippine time, depending on Australian daylight saving)

• Paid trial: The first three months are a paid trial. At the end, we review fit and performance together.

• Salary reviews: Raises based on performance, added responsibilities and company growth

• Career path: The role can grow into a Senior Client Success / Operations Manager position: leading a team, owning processes and overseeing client delivery

• Long-term and remote: A permanent, 100% remote position, not a short-term project

• Real ownership: You'll own client relationships and day-to-day delivery, not just follow instructions





WHAT WE VALUE



Reliability, initiative, clear communication and long-term commitment. We're building Reviewfy into a scalable agency based on strong systems and great client experiences. We want someone who will grow with it and eventually help lead our client success team.





HOW TO APPLY



Send the following:



1. Subject line: "Reviewfy CSM – [Your Name]"

2. Your CV

3. A 2–3 minute voice/video recording (Vocaroo or Loom). Introduce yourself and tell us about a time you had to get something from a client who wasn't responding. What did you do?

4. Short answers to these questions:

   - Which CRM and marketing tools have you used, and for how long?

   - Have you worked with Australian, US or UK clients? In what role?

   - Does the compensation above work for you, and when can you start?



Applications without a voice/video recording will not be reviewed. Shortlisted candidates will have a 20-minute video interview, including a short role-play of a client call.

title: Email Marketing Designer (Ecommerce)
description:

About us

The Sender Studio is a boutique
 marketing studio for eCommerce brands. We build done-for-you
 and retention systems on Klaviyo, Shopify and Okendo. We keep things clear over clever, and we treat
 as a relationship channel, not a hard sell.



We're a small team and we're growing. We're looking for a part-time
 designer to start straight away, with room to grow into a bigger role.



The role

What You'll Be Doing

- Proactive Support & Product Feedback: Keep an eye on platform usage, reach out when engagement dips, answer questions quickly, and pass merchant feedback directly to our product team.

- A strong, above-market base salary that reflects your skills and experience.

- A permanent, 100% work-from-home role with no commute and no office mandates.

- Direct access to our founders and core team—no middlemen or unnecessary layers.

- Clear opportunities to grow and move into higher-level roles as our company expands.

title: Executive Assistant to the CEO
description:
The primary purpose of this role is to save the CEO's time by independently managing day-to-day communication, organizing priorities, coordinating follow-ups, and keeping customer relationships and sales opportunities moving forward.



You must safeguard the CEO's time by handling 80–90% of this communication yourself, so the CEO only steps in on decisions that genuinely require the CEO.



This is not a data-entry or task-taking VA role. We are looking for someone exceptionally organized, detail-oriented and proactive, who anticipates needs, uses sound judgment, takes ownership and makes sure nothing falls through the cracks.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



1. EXECUTIVE ASSISTANCE & INBOX MANAGEMENT (TOP PRIORITY)

• CEO inbox ownership: Monitor, sort and prioritize incoming emails; identify time-sensitive customer, supplier and operational matters; flag only decisions requiring the CEO's input.

• Professional email correspondence: Draft and, within agreed authority, send accurate, thoughtful replies in the CEO's voice; maintain clear threads, prompt responses and a consistent premium brand tone.

• Follow-through and reminders: Turn messages and meetings into actionable tasks, deadlines and follow-ups; proactively chase outstanding replies and close loops without repeated direction.

• Calendar and coordination: Assist with scheduling calls, coordinating across time zones, preparing concise meeting notes and organizing relevant background information.

• Executive leverage: Provide concise daily priority summaries, suggest draft responses or next steps, and reduce unnecessary administrative back-and-forth.



2. CUSTOMER SUPPORT & SALES PIPELINE MANAGEMENT (TOP PRIORITY)

• Customer communication: Act as a polished first point of contact for customer emails, SMS, live chat and phone inquiries during scheduled coverage; handle routine matters independently and escalate sensitive or high-impact issues promptly.

• CRM ownership: Keep ClickUp and/or the company's CRM accurate and current: lead source, stage, contact details, preferences, quotation status, order value, last interaction, next action and follow-up date.

• Proactive sales follow-up: Ensure leads are followed up consistently after inquiries, swatch requests, design discussions and quotations; coordinate closely with the sales lead so warm opportunities do not go cold.

• Pipeline visibility: Maintain a clear view of active opportunities, stalled leads, overdue follow-ups and customer objections; prepare concise pipeline updates for the CEO and sales team.

• Customer journey coordination: Keep handoffs organized from first inquiry through quotation, deposit, production, shipping and post-delivery support.

• Customer detail accuracy: Carefully verify names, product specifications, quantities, pricing, timelines, addresses and commitments before entering data or communicating with customers.

• Shipment and after-sales updates: Coordinate with logistics partners to send scheduled shipment updates, even where there is no status change; manage satisfaction checks, reviews and referral outreach.



3. SUPPORTING RESPONSIBILITIES

• Website and listings: upload and update products on our websites with accurate pricing, SEO-friendly copy, specifications, images and variants. Keep our Google Business Profile updated.

• Configurator and site quality: work with our IT and 3D teams on configurator content and fabric swatches. Test checkout and follow up on issues until they are resolved.

• Marketing coordination: coordinate asset requests and content briefs in ClickUp, handle non-sales social messages, and keep image and document libraries organized.

• Research and records: research competitors, white-glove delivery providers, and local dispatch partners; summarize actionable findings for management.

• Record keeping: Maintain accurate pricing records, product updates, spreadsheets and internal process documentation.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



WHAT YOU BRING



MUST HAVE

• Executive assistant experience: 2+ years supporting an executive or senior manager, with real responsibility for email, coordination and follow-through.

• Strong written and spoken English: you write polished emails independently and can communicate confidently with customers by phone and live chat.

• Sales and CRM experience: you have managed leads, pipeline stages and follow-up schedules in a CRM, including proactive follow-up by email, SMS and phone.

• Exceptional attention to detail: you are meticulous with names, figures, specifications, dates and commitments, and you research and verify before acting or replying.

• Premium customer service: experience in luxury, high-ticket, custom-order or consultative sales.

• Ownership and judgment: you prioritize independently, anticipate next steps, and escalate only when needed, always with context and a proposed solution.

• Systems and tools: comfortable with Gmail, ClickUp (or a similar CRM), Excel, Word and PowerPoint, and quick to learn new tools.

• Working schedule: reliable availability during agreed California afternoon hours, with dependable internet and a professional remote work environment.



NICE TO HAVE

• E-commerce and WordPress: Hands-on experience with website backends, product listings or configurator tools.

• Related tools and industries: Experience with furniture/interior design, Canva, Photoshop, SEO tools or online marketplaces such as Etsy and eBay.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS



• Inbox under control daily: The CEO's inbox is organized each working day; urgent messages and decisions are promptly surfaced, and assigned emails receive professional responses within agreed service levels.

• CEO messages acknowledged within 5 minutes: During scheduled working hours, except while actively handling another urgent assignment or customer call.
