title: Field Operations Manager
description:
Field Operations Manager



Remote, Philippines-based  |  Australian & New Zealand market research  |  Full-time contract



TKW Research collects survey data for research agencies, government and pollsters in Australia and New Zealand. Most of it is done by phone from our centres in Fiji and Australia. The rest is done face to face: our interviewers work in shopping centres, transport hubs, events and streets across Australia and New Zealand, with a tablet, asking people to take part in a survey.



We need someone in the Philippines to run that face-to-face team. You won't meet most of them in person. You will still be the person who hires them, rosters them, keeps them productive, sorts out their problems when a tablet won't sync at 8am in Auckland, and makes sure every interview they bring back is genuine.

What the job involves



• Recruiting casual field interviewers in Australian and New Zealand cities: writing the ads, interviewing by video, checking references, and getting new starters trained and set up on their tablets.



• Building rosters around client deadlines, quotas and locations, and rebuilding them when someone calls in sick or the weather turns.



• Watching progress through the day (surveys per hour, quotas, locations) and acting before a shortfall turns into a missed deadline.



• Remote support for interviewers on their tablets and survey software.



• Quality checking. We are ISO 20252 certified, so every project is checked: interview lengths, timestamps, locations and call-backs to respondents. You'll own that for the field team.



• Daily and weekly reporting to our Head of Operations.



• You won't be on your own. Two of our senior people have run this field operation themselves, and they'll be there to guide you while you learn our clients and systems.



What we're looking for



• At least three years managing a team you can't see. Field interviewers or enumerators are ideal; merchandisers, promo staff or a spread-out operations team also count. If you've run face-to-face survey fieldwork, tell us. It matters.



• You've hired people yourself, not only supervised people someone else hired.



• English good enough, written and spoken, that an Australian interviewer or client never has to ask you to repeat yourself.



• At home with spreadsheets and Android and iOS tablets, and quick to learn new software.



• You stay calm when the plan falls apart at 7am, and you finish the job without anyone chasing you.



The honest part: hours and pressure



Please read this part before you apply. Fieldwork follows Australian and New Zealand daylight. In summer, 9am in Auckland is 4am in Manila and 9am in Sydney is 6am. During busy field periods we work seven days a week, and short-notice changes happen. Because the day follows Australian and NZ daylight, it usually finishes early afternoon Manila time. But this is not a 9-to-6 job, and we'd rather tell you now than lose you in month two.



Our clients are experienced researchers with tight deadlines and high standards. When something goes wrong in the field, you'll be the one on the phone explaining what happened and how you're fixing it. We back our people when that happens, but you need to be someone who can take a hard conversation and keep going.



Pay and conditions



• PHP 100,000 to 130,000 per month, depending on your experience



• A December service payment equal to one month's fee



• HMO reimbursement of up to PHP 50,000 a year for you and one dependent



• PHP 3,000 a month towards your equipment and internet



• Australian public holidays off with no reduction in your fee, and 10 days of planned leave a year after 12 months



• Paid training, and a structured review at six months



• A full-time, exclusive independent contractor engagement with TKW Collective (NZ) Ltd, trading as TKW Research



You'll need a quiet home office, a reliable main internet connection with a backup, and backup power.



About TKW Research



TKW Research is an Australian-owned data collection company with operations in Australia, New Zealand and Fiji, certified to ISO 20252:2019 for market, opinion and social research. Find us at 
 and on LinkedIn.



How to apply



Apply through this listing with the subject line Field Ops Manager – [your name], and include all three of the following:



1. Your CV.



2. Short answers, in your own words (we'll talk about them in the interview): (a) the largest team you've managed that you couldn't see in person: how many people, where, and doing what? (b) how did you know by mid-morning whether the day was on track? (c) one time you found that someone's work wasn't genuine or wasn't up to standard: what tipped you off, and what did you do?



3. A two-minute voice recording (any free app is fine). Introduce yourself, then explain how you would welcome a new interviewer on their first shift.



We won't review applications that are missing any of these. We're reading applications as they arrive and closing on Sunday 13 December 2026, so earlier is better. We'd like you to start as early as possible in January 2027.



We will never ask you to pay for anything: not training, not equipment, not a background check. Everyone who contacts you about this role will be from 
 address or a named TKW manager on LinkedIn.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
Social Media Manager, Yamato Izakaya



About Yamato

Yamato Izakaya has fed Singapore for 8 years. We are a 150-seat, dog-friendly izakaya built for big groups: big menu, big tables. Our regulars are office teams, neighbourhood families and travellers who found us on the way through.

We want more people to know we exist. That is your job.



The role

You own Yamato's Instagram (and any other channel we add) end to end: planning, shooting, posting, replying, and reporting what worked. The goal is simple: more tables filled, more group bookings, more people walking in because of something they saw.



What you'll do

• Plan a monthly content calendar and get it approved before the month starts

• Shoot and edit photos, Reels and Stories on site (food, drinks, the room, the team, the dogs)

• Write captions in Yamato's voice and post on schedule

• Reply to comments and DMs within the same day, and route booking enquiries to the team

• Grow engagement through trends, collabs, giveaways, UGC reposts and local food creators

• Promote group bookings, events, set menus and seasonal specials

• Send a short monthly report: reach, followers, engagement, and what drove bookings



Who we're looking for

• 1 to 2 years running social for an F&B, lifestyle or hospitality brand (freelance counts)

• Does not run everything through Chatgpt and actually has a human brain, including communication in English.

• Strong on phone photography and short-form video editing (CapCut, Lightroom or similar)

• Writes captions that sound like a person, not a brand

• Knows the Singapore food scene and who the local food creators are

• Self-directed: can plan, shoot and post without being chased

• Bonus: interest in Japanese food and drink culture



Application task

We hire on this task more than the CV. Send all three parts.

1.  Portfolio. 3 to 5 accounts or posts you've run or made, with links. Tell us what you did on each and any results (reach, follower growth, bookings).

2.  Three example posts for Yamato. Use only photos and videos already on our Instagram feed. For each post, give us:

    ◦ The visual (re-edited, cropped, or turned into a Reel or carousel)

    ◦ The full caption and hashtags

    ◦ The format and when you'd post it

    ◦ One line on why it would work

3.  Engagement plan. In one page or less: how would you get more people engaging with Yamato and booking a table in your first 90 days? Be specific. Name formats, ideas, creators or collabs, and how you'd measure it.



How to apply

 
] with the subject "Social Media Manager: [Your Name]". Attach your CV and all three parts of the task as one PDF or a shared Google Drive link.

Role type: [Full-time / Part-time / Freelance] Pay: [Range] Deadline: [Date]

We reply to every applicant whose task we review.

title: Shopify eCommerce Growth & Development Manager | Hands-On Store Ownership | Remote
description:
**Job Type:** Part-time initially, with potential for long-term growth\

**Location:** Remote\

**Industry:** Australian eCommerce / Online Retail



## About the Role



We are an Australian company managing and developing multiple eCommerce brands. We are looking for an experienced, hands-on **Shopify eCommerce Growth & Development Manager** who can take ownership of developing, improving, and growing our online stores.



**This is NOT a routine Shopify Store Administrator, Product Listing VA, or Order Management position.**



We need someone who understands how to build and develop an eCommerce business, not simply maintain its daily operations.



Your main responsibility will be to identify opportunities, plan improvements, and personally implement changes that enhance our Shopify stores, improve the customer journey, increase conversions, and support sustainable business growth.



You should be comfortable working both strategically and practically. We are not looking for someone who only prepares plans and delegates tasks. You must be capable of executing a significant portion of the work yourself.



Initially, the role will focus heavily on Shopify website development, store improvements, and conversion optimisation. Over time, responsibilities may expand into social media, digital marketing, brand development, and other growth initiatives.



## Key Responsibilities



**1. Shopify Store Development & Improvement (Primary Focus)**



- Take ownership of ongoing Shopify store development and improvement projects.

- Review existing stores, identify weaknesses, and recommend practical solutions.

- Improve homepage layouts, product pages, collections, navigation, menus, and overall website structure.

- Implement Shopify theme customisations, app configurations, and website enhancements.

- Develop new landing pages, promotional pages, product launches, and conversion-focused content.

- Coordinate with developers or designers for more technical tasks when required.



**2. Customer Journey & Conversion Optimisation**

- Identify friction points affecting customer experience, trust, and purchasing decisions.

- Improve product presentation, calls to action, mobile experience, and checkout flow.

- Recommend and implement improvements to increase conversion rates and average order value.

- Review competitor websites and introduce relevant improvements and best practices.

- Use Shopify Analytics, GA4, heatmaps, and other tools to identify improvement opportunities.



**3. eCommerce Business Development & Growth**



- Develop practical action plans for improving online store performance and sales.

- Identify opportunities for new products, bundles, promotions, upselling, and cross-selling.

- Support new brand launches and the development of new Shopify stores.

- Coordinate projects from initial concept through implementation and performance review.

- Monitor store performance, evaluate results, and continuously recommend improvements.



**4. Marketing & Brand Development (Secondary / Future Focus)**



- Support social media strategy, content planning, and brand development.

- Coordinate with designers, content creators, influencers, and marketing specialists.

- Assist with
 marketing, SEO, promotional campaigns, and customer retention initiatives.

- Identify opportunities to improve brand visibility, engagement, and customer acquisition.



## Mandatory Requirements



- Minimum **3 years of relevant hands-on Shopify and eCommerce development experience**.

- Demonstrated experience improving or developing Shopify stores, not just managing daily operations.

- Strong understanding of website UX, customer journey, conversion optimisation, and online sales.

- Ability to implement Shopify improvements independently, including themes, apps, pages, and store configurations.

- Proven experience taking ownership of projects from planning through execution.

- Ability to analyse problems, propose solutions, and implement improvements without constant instructions.

- Experience working with Australian eCommerce businesses.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Strong organisational skills, initiative, accountability, and attention to detail.



**Highly Regarded**



- Experience managing multiple eCommerce brands or working in an eCommerce agency.

- Shopify Liquid, HTML, CSS, or other relevant technical skills.

- Shopify SEO, Google Analytics 4, Google Merchant Center, and conversion tracking.

- Klaviyo,
 marketing, and customer retention strategies.

- Social media strategy and content development.

- Experience launching new online stores or developing brands from scratch.



## Who Should Apply?



We are particularly interested in candidates who can confidently say:



- I have personally built, developed, or significantly improved Shopify stores.

- I understand what makes customers trust a website and complete a purchase.

- I can independently identify problems and implement practical improvements.

- I can manage projects and deliver measurable outcomes, not just complete assigned tasks.

- I understand how different elements of an eCommerce business work together to generate sales.



**Please do not apply if your experience is primarily limited to product uploads, order processing, inventory updates, customer service, or routine store administration.**



## Mandatory Self-Assessment



Please rate your skills in each area using **None / Basic / Professional**.



1. Shopify store setup and development

2. Shopify theme customisation and editing

3. Shopify apps and integrations

4. Website UX and customer journey improvement

5. Conversion rate optimisation (CRO)

6. Product page and landing page development

7. Shopify store audits and performance improvement

8. Shopify Analytics and Google Analytics 4

9. eCommerce business growth strategy

10. Product launches, bundles, upselling, and promotions

11. Shopify SEO and website content optimisation

12. Shopify Liquid / HTML / CSS

13. eCommerce project management and ownership

14. Competitor research and market analysis

15. Klaviyo and
 marketing

16. Social media strategy and content development

17. Coordination of designers, developers, and marketers

18. Experience supporting Australian eCommerce businesses



## How to Apply



Please submit:



**1. Resume and relevant experience**



Include your years of Shopify experience and details of Australian eCommerce businesses you have supported.



**2. Shopify Portfolio – Mandatory**



Provide links to at least **three Shopify stores** you have personally developed, significantly improved, or managed through major enhancement projects.



For each store, briefly explain:



- What was the situation or problem?

- What improvements did you personally implement?

- What results did you achieve?



**3. Introduction Video – Maximum 3 Minutes**



Record a short video explaining:

## Important Application Notes



Applications without the required **portfolio, introduction video, and completed self-assessment** will not be considered.

title: Part-Time Financial Reporting Analyst / Management Accountant
description:
**Job Type:** Part-time, long-term independent contractor  

**Location:** Remote – Philippines  

**Working Hours:** Approximately 15 hours per week  

**Monthly Compensation:** PHP 25,000–30,000, depending on qualifications and experience  

**Industry:** Manufacturing and Construction  

**Reporting To:** Chief Financial Officer (CFO)



## About Us



We are an established and growing Australian group of companies specialising in aluminium manufacturing, fabrication and powder coating, with operations across Australia. 



As part of our business expansion, we are looking for a highly analytical, detail-oriented and trustworthy Financial Reporting Analyst to support our management team with financial reporting, business performance analysis and financial planning.



This position is primarily focused on management accounting and financial analysis rather than day-to-day bookkeeping.



## Key Responsibilities



### Weekly Financial Reporting



- Prepare weekly revenue and expenditure reports.

- Analyse accounts receivable and accounts payable.

- Monitor labour costs and operating expenses.

- Identify unusual transactions and significant expense movements.

- Prepare weekly financial summaries for management.



### Monthly Financial Reporting



- Prepare profit and loss reports across multiple business entities.

- Conduct financial performance and profitability analysis.

- Prepare budget versus actual reports and variance analysis.

- Analyse gross profit margins and operating expenses.

- Prepare labour cost and operational efficiency reports.

- Compare financial performance across different business locations.

- Assist with balance sheet reviews and cash flow analysis.

- Maintain financial dashboards and management KPIs.

- Provide written commentary explaining significant financial movements, potential risks and areas for improvement.



### Quarterly Financial Reporting



- Prepare quarterly financial performance reviews.

- Conduct year-on-year financial comparisons.

- Assist with financial forecasting and budgeting.

- Identify cost-saving opportunities and operational inefficiencies.

- Provide actionable financial recommendations to management.



### Process Improvement



- Develop and maintain standardised financial reporting templates.

- Identify opportunities to automate repetitive reporting processes.

- Verify financial data for accuracy and consistency.

- Liaise with the internal accounting team when discrepancies are identified.

- Maintain clear documentation of reporting procedures.



## Qualifications and Requirements



- Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or a related discipline.

- Minimum of three years of relevant experience in financial reporting, management accounting or financial analysis.

- Strong understanding of financial statements and accounting principles.

- Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including PivotTables, XLOOKUP, SUMIFS and financial modelling.

- Experience with Xero accounting software.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Excellent written English and professional communication skills.

- Ability to work independently and meet reporting deadlines.

- Exceptional attention to detail, integrity and confidentiality.



## Preferred Qualifications



- Certified Public Accountant (CPA), CMA or equivalent professional qualification.

- Experience working with Australian businesses.

- Experience in manufacturing, construction or industrial businesses.

- Experience with multi-entity financial reporting.

- Experience with Power BI, Power Query or other financial reporting and automation tools.



## Confidentiality and Data Security



This position involves handling confidential commercial and financial information. The successful candidate must demonstrate a high level of professional integrity and comply with all company confidentiality and data security requirements.



Financial information will be provided through approved company systems and restricted-access files. Signing a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) will be required.



## Working Arrangement



- Approximately 15 hours per week.

- Flexible working hours, subject to reporting deadlines and scheduled management meetings.

- Initial one-month paid trial period.

- Long-term engagement subject to satisfactory performance.

- Opportunity for professional growth as the business continues to expand.



## What We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who goes beyond simply preparing financial reports.



The ideal candidate should be able to interpret financial data, explain why business performance has changed, identify potential financial risks and provide practical recommendations to support management decisions.



Accuracy, accountability, confidentiality and independent thinking are essential.



## How to Apply



Please submit the following:



1. Your updated CV.

2. A brief introduction outlining your financial reporting and management accounting experience.

3. Details of your experience with Xero and Microsoft Excel.

4. An anonymised or sample financial report or dashboard you have personally prepared.

5. Your expected monthly compensation and weekly availability.

6. Your answers to the following questions:



- How would you investigate a decline in gross profit margin when sales revenue has increased?

- What financial reports would you recommend to the CFO of a manufacturing business, and why?

- How would you ensure the accuracy of financial reports across multiple business entities?

- How do you manage and protect confidential financial information when working remotely?



Please include **“FINANCIAL ANALYST – ALUMI”** in your application subject line.



Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted for an interview and practical financial assessment.

title: 3D Children's Animator & YouTube Producer
description:
Send your work to my
 please 



Joe’s Laundry League is seeking a creative 3D animation producer to bring our children’s educational YouTube series to life.



We provide the characters, scripts, storylines, and episode plans. Your responsibility is to produce complete animated episodes.



Responsibilities:



* Produce a minimum of 2 complete animated episodes per month.

* Each episode should be approximately 10 minutes long.

* Animate characters talking, walking, playing, and interacting naturally.

* Maintain consistent character designs, appearances, and personalities.

* Use 3D animation software along with AI-assisted tools when helpful.

* Use AI-generated voices with accurate lip-syncing.

* Add background music, sound effects, and professional editing.

* Deliver high-quality, child-friendly YouTube episodes.

* No low-quality shortcuts or entirely AI-generated episodes.



Requirements:



* Experience with children’s 3D animation.

* Reliable PC with substantial available storage, preferably 1 TB.

* Ability to deliver two finished episodes monthly.

* Fast turnaround, creativity, and attention to detail.



Payment: Fixed monthly production package.



To Apply: Submit your animation portfolio, software used, and price for producing two complete 10-minute episodes per month.

title: US CPA / Senior Accountant (Microsoft Dynamics GP / Great Plains)
description:
We are looking for an experienced, detail-oriented US CPA who is available to start immediately. You will work directly and live with our US-based client, handling core accounting operations using Microsoft Dynamics GP (Great Plains).



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Manage daily accounting tasks, reconciliations, and financial reporting inside Microsoft Dynamics GP (Great Plains)

- Collaborate live with the US client team during scheduled shift hours

- Maintain accurate general ledger entries, accounts payable/receivable, and month-end close processes



REQUIREMENTS:

- Active US CPA license (or verified US CPA background)

- Proven hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics GP (Great Plains) — QuickBooks-only experience will not be considered

- Solid background in US accounting standards and enterprise accounting workflows

- Schedule: Must be able to work live on US Pacific Time (PT), starting around 11:00 PM PT (approx. 3:00 PM Philippine Time)

- Availability: Ready to start immediately

- Reliable high-speed internet connection and clear English communication skills



HOW TO APPLY:

Please send your updated resume along with a brief summary of your Microsoft Dynamics GP (Great Plains) experience and confirmation that you can work the 11:00 PM PT live schedule.

title: Part-Time Recruiter
description:
Position: Part-Time Recruiter (Full-Cycle, Multi-Channel)

Hours: 20 hours per week (4 hours/day, Monday–Friday)

Schedule: 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM Sydney time, with some flexibility for interviews across Australian and PH time zones

Location: Remote

Engagement: Independent contractor, 3-month trial period; hours may increase based on hiring volume and performance

Reports to Head of Operations

Time tracking: Time-tracking software required during working

hours



About Us

We are a growing Australian group in the independent optical and eye-health space. Our

businesses span lens supply, a professional network for independent optometrists,

practice software, owned optometry practices, and several ventures outside optometry.



About the Role

We are hiring across marketing, development, finance, operations, and clinical education at the same time, and we need one person to own the pipeline. You will run full-cycle recruitment for multiple open roles at once, from intake to signed offer. You will source well beyond one job board, actively headhunting on LinkedIn and across local and international platforms.



Item Detail

Position Part-Time Recruiter (Full-Cycle, Multi-Channel)

Hours 20 hours per week (4 hours/day, Monday–Friday)

Schedule 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM Sydney time, with some

flexibility for interviews across Australian and

PH time zones

Location Remote

Engagement: Independent contractor, 3-month trial period;

hours may increase based on hiring volume and performance

Reports to Head of Operations

Time tracking: Time-tracking software required during working hours



Job Description



You will work closely with the Head of Operations and our hiring managers, who will lean

on you to deliver shortlists, not just applicants.



Key Responsibilities

Intake & planning: Hold intake calls with hiring managers to agree on must-haves, hours, budget, timeline, and interview

stages for each role

Job ads: Write and adapt job descriptions and ads for each channel; follow our confidentiality guidelines on what is shown publicly

Sourcing & headhunting: Post roles and actively search candidate databases, LinkedIn, and talent pools; reach out directly to passive candidates

Screening: Review CVs and portfolios, run first-round screening calls, and send hiring managers a scored

shortlist with notes

Assessments: Coordinate skills tests and work samples (e.g. design, writing, coding, finance tasks) and track results

Interview coordination: Schedule interviews across Australian and PH time zones, prepare interview packs, and collect feedback within 24 hours

Candidate experience: Keep every candidate informed at each stage,

including timely, professional rejections

Offers & handover: Run reference checks, prepare offer details for approval, and hand new hires over for onboarding

(forms, NDAs, contracts)

Tracking & reporting: Keep the recruitment tracker current in our project management tool; send a weekly update on

pipeline status, time-to-hire and channel spend





Roles You'll Recruit For

You will handle a mix of remote and Australia-based roles, from entry-level VAs to senior leadership.

Sourcing Channels: You will choose the right channel for each role and report on which ones deliver hires, not

just applicants.

Area: What you'll do: Talent pool: Build and maintain a pool of pre-screened candidates for recurring roles (VAs, designers,

developers) so we can backfill quickly. Function Example roles Typical seniority

Marketing & creative: Marketing VAs, social media and Canva designers, video editors, graphic designers,

WordPress/web support, SEO specialists

Junior to mid: Software development Developers (front-end, back-end, C#/.NET,

integrations), QA and customer support, project managers

Mid to senior: Finance, Bookkeepers, accountants, finance leadership

Mid to senior: Operations & admin: Sales and marketing coordinators, operations assistants

Junior to mid: Clinical & education (Australia), Clinical education specialists and optometry-related roles

Mid to senior: Affiliated businesses Technical and operational roles for partner companies within our network Varies





You will also recommend when to boost, extend, or pause a paid post based on applicant

quality and cost.

What Success Looks Like

These targets will be reviewed at the end of the 3-month trial.

Channel Best for OnlineJobs.ph Remote VAs, designers, editors, developers

LinkedIn (job posts and direct outreach)

Developers, project managers, finance and

clinical roles; headhunting passive candidates

SEEK Australia-based roles

JobStreet, Indeed, Kalibrr: Philippines-based professional and technical roles

 groups and niche communities

Creative, VA and freelance talent

Referrals and talent pool: Fast backfills and trusted candidates



Measure Target

First shortlist delivered within 5 business days of intake

Shortlist quality: At least half of shortlisted candidates progress to a hiring-manager interview

Time to hire: 30 days or less for junior/mid roles; 45 days or less for senior roles

Candidate response time: Every applicant updated within 3 business days of each stage

Tracker accuracy: Pipeline tracker updated daily; weekly report sent every Friday

New hire retention: Hires pass their trial or probation period





What You'll Bring

Must have 3+ years of full-cycle recruitment experience, in-house or agency

Proven experience recruiting remote talent for Australian or other international companies

Hands-on experience with OnlineJobs.ph, LinkedIn (including direct sourcing and outreach), and at least one other major job board

Ability to manage 5 or more open roles at once without losing track of candidates

Strong written and spoken English; able to write clear, compelling job ads

Sound judgement in screening; able to spot red flags and assess both skills and culture fit

Organised and detail-oriented, with experience keeping a recruitment tracker or ATS current

Discretion with confidential information (pay, candidate details, internal matters)

Reliable internet connection, backup power, and a quiet workspace for calls



A Great Plus

Experience in any of the following will make you stand out:

Recruiting for technical roles (developers, QA, project managers)

Hiring through SEEK and for the Australian market

Using LinkedIn Recruiter or Recruiter Lite for sourcing

Using ClickUp, Slack or similar collaboration tools

Recruiting in healthcare, optical or eCommerce



How to Apply

Send the following:

1. Your CV

2. A short cover note (max 200 words) describing the hardest role you have filled and how you found the hire

3. The job boards and sourcing tools you have used in the past 12 months

4. Your availability to work 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM Sydney time, Monday–Friday

5. Your expected hourly rate







Shortlisted applicants will complete a short practical task (writing a job ad and a sourcing

plan for a sample role) before the final interview.

title: Simple Copy-Paste AI Video Task Operator (Zero Experience, Chill Work, 30-40h/Wk)
description:
Hi there, I'm Bartosz.



If you are tired of job posts that ask you to do five different jobs at once for low pay, please read this. We are a fast-growing European e-commerce brand, and we are expanding our daily AI video production team in the Philippines.



We built our own automated system that writes all our scripts and edits all our video ads automatically. We only need reliable, detail-oriented people to click and generate the short 6 to 10 second raw clips inside Google Flow.



You need zero prior experience. If you know how to copy, paste, switch between Chrome tabs, and check that a short video clip looks clean, you can learn this job in 10 minutes. It is calm, chill, repeatable work. Put on music, a podcast, or an audiobook in the background and get into a comfortable flow. No phone calls, no Zoom meetings, and no stressful micromanagement.



At the same time, we are looking for people who want consistent, serious weekly hours (at least 25 to 40+ hours per week, part-time or full-time) and want to stay with us as long as possible. We care a lot about quality and reliability, and as our brand keeps growing, our best operators get more volume, higher rates, and long-term security.



How pay works (100% transparent per clip + bonuses):

- Every single approved clip pays $0.014 USD right away (one typical ad batch of 20 clips is $0.28, and fast operators run 2 to 3 Google Flow tabs at once to finish 150 to 210+ clips every hour).

- What that means per month: if you treat this like a steady 8-hour full-time schedule, completing 1,300 to 1,700 clips a day earns you $18 to $24+ per day, which comes out to $420 to $580+ USD per month before bonuses. If you do 25 to 30 hours per week, expect around $280 to $400 USD per month.

- Extra volume and quality bonuses: hit clean weekly clip milestones with high accuracy and get an extra $15 to $40 weekly bonus, plus rate bumps up to $0.018 per clip for our top long-term teammates.

- Live "You Have Earned" counter: our custom workspace displays your exact USD earnings at the top of your screen and updates immediately on every clip you upload.

- Weekly Friday payouts: sent every Friday like clockwork via Wise, PayPal, or GCash.

- Zero costs to you: we supply all paid Google Flow accounts and step-by-step training.



What you actually do:

1. Log into our clean Clip Workspace when you start your shift.

2. Grab a card from the queue, click "Copy Prompt", and save the reference image.

3. Paste them into our Google Flow account with the exact setting shown on the card.

4. While Tab 1 generates, paste the next card into Tab 2 and Tab 3 so you never sit around waiting.

5. Before uploading the MP4, check for 5 seconds that the spoken sentence is complete (first and last word clearly audible) and the face, hands, and product label look normal. If AI made a glitch, hit regenerate.



Who we want on our team:

- Available at least 25+ hours per week (35 to 40 hours per week full-time is strongly preferred) and looking for stable, long-term work.

- Honest, careful, and patient enough to check every clip properly instead of rushing bad files.

- Laptop or desktop PC (8GB+ RAM) with fast, stable internet (25+ Mbps).



How to apply (includes a paid 15-minute test batch):

Reply here on OnlineJobs.ph and start your message with the word ROCKET on the first line so I know you read the whole post.



In a few short, normal sentences written by you (not ChatGPT), let me know:

1. Your first name, city, and how many hours per week you want to work (25h, 30h, or 40h+ full-time).

2. Confirm that you understand you do not need editing experience, just fast clicking and careful quality checking.

3. Quick check: what should you do if Google Flow generates a clip where the first word of speech is cut off or our product label looks blurry?

4. Your internet speed (Mbps) and computer specs.



If you are interested, please contact me on whatsapp: 
and write "click" as a message so I understand you actually read the offer. Thank you!



Shortlisted applicants get a paid 5-clip test drive right away. Talk soon!



Best,

Bartosz

title: High-Volume Wedding Photo Color Correction Artists (Lightroom + AI Workflow)
description:
Location: Remote (Philippines-based)

Role Type: Freelance / Contractor (Per-Gig / Per-Wedding Basis)

Capacity: Up to Full-Time Equivalent (~15 weddings/month per editor)



About the Role

We are a global wedding photography company seeking up to 4 reliable, detail-oriented photo color correction artists based in the Philippines.



In this role, you will handle the post-production color grading and correction pipeline, transforming RAW wedding captures into consistent, gallery-ready, high-resolution JPEGs that match our signature look.



We heavily leverage modern editing workflows—pairing Adobe Lightroom Classic with AI-assisted editing tools (AfterShoot) to achieve fast, cohesive results across diverse lighting and venue conditions.



Key Responsibilities

Color Correction & Exposure Balancing: Correct white balance, tint, exposure, highlights, shadows, and skin tones across full wedding galleries (typically 1,500–4,000+ RAW images per wedding).



AI-Assisted Workflow Integration: Run catalogs through AI profiles, then perform meticulous manual QC and secondary adjustments to ensure every frame is cohesive.



Volume & Consistency: Successfully turnaround an average of 12–15 weddings per month while adhering strictly to our brand presets and style guides.



Export & Delivery: Export optimized high-resolution JPEGs following exact file-naming, sizing, and sharpening protocols within agreed deadlines.



Feedback Implementation: Apply constructive client feedback and make timely revisions when required.



Requirements & Qualifications

Proven Experience: Demonstrable portfolio or track record editing high-volume event/wedding galleries.



Software Mastery: Expert proficiency in Adobe Lightroom Classic (smart previews, catalogs, batch editing) and hands-on familiarity with AI culling/editing software (ImagenAI, AfterShoot, or similar).



Color Sensitivity: Sharp eye for natural, flattering skin tones across diverse skin complexions and varying light environments (direct sun, golden hour, tungsten, reception flash).



Hardware & Connectivity:



High-performance PC or Mac capable of smoothly handling large RAW files and catalog batches.



Color-accurate, calibrated monitor.



Reliable high-speed internet connection (minimum 50+ Mbps download/upload) with a dependable backup plan for power and internet interruptions.



Work Ethic: Strong time management, high reliability, and clear written English communication.



Compensation & Work Setup

Pay Structure: Paid per gig / per wedding completed (rates discussed upon application).



Volume: Steady flow of projects throughout the peak wedding seasons, with potential for long-term ongoing collaboration.



Flexible Hours: Work on your own schedule as long as delivery milestones (typically 1 week turnaround per gallery once assigned) are consistently met.



How to Apply

To apply, please submit the following:



Portfolio / Before-and-Afters: A link to a portfolio or Google Drive showing before-and-after samples of your wedding color correction work (particularly skin tone rendering and reception lighting).



Workflow Summary: A quick overview of your current tech setup (computer specs, monitor, internet speed) and which AI editing tools you use regularly.



Capacity: Your current monthly editing availability.



Paid Trial: Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a short, paid test gallery to evaluate style matching, color consistency, and turnaround speed.

title: Senior US Tax Accountant
description:
JOB RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO:



Tax Preparation & Compliance

*Independently prepare and review US federal and state tax returns, including Forms 1040, 1120, 1120-S, and 1065.

*Manage approximately 100 annual returns across individual and business clients.

*Prepare complex multi entity returns, including partnership and S corporation reporting, shareholder and partner basis calculations, K-1s, and related schedules.

*Analyze financial statements, prior-year returns, accounting records, and supporting documentation for accuracy and completeness.

*Prepare tax adjustments, reconciliations, and year-end journal entries.

*Maintain accurate workpapers and supporting documentation.

*Research federal and state tax regulations, identify technical issues, and recommend appropriate treatment.

*Prepare extensions, estimated tax calculations, and required compliance filings.

*Research and prepare responses to IRS and state tax notices and correspondence.

*Complete first-level technical reviews and submit work for final approval.

*Proactively manage filing deadlines and identify missing information or potential compliance issues.



Tax Planning & Strategy

*Prepare comprehensive federal and state income tax projections for business owners and their entities throughout the year.

*Identify and evaluate tax-saving opportunities involving entity structures, owner compensation, retirement plans, deductions, credits, distributions, and other planning strategies.

*Research advanced tax issues involving multiple business entities and overlapping individual and business tax considerations.

*Model alternative strategies and calculate their financial and tax implications.

*Prepare detailed calculations and clear strategy recommendations for founder review.

*Monitor legislative and regulatory changes affecting our clients.

*Collaborate with the bookkeeping and CFO teams to ensure accounting records support accurate and effective tax planning.

*Assist with implementing approved tax strategies and monitoring their results.



Payroll & Accounting Coordination

*Process monthly payroll through our payroll software.

*Review quarterly and annual federal and state payroll tax filings for accuracy and completeness.

*Prepare manual payroll tax filings for specialized client arrangements, including family management companies.

*Reconcile payroll records, tax liabilities, employee compensation, and bookkeeping accounts.

*Review payroll-related adjusting journal entries and year-end accounting records.

*Ensure accurate reporting of shareholder compensation, payroll deductions, benefits, and other tax-sensitive payroll transactions.

*Coordinate with the bookkeeping team to resolve discrepancies and maintain accurate financial records.



Tax Operations & Team Collaboration

*Independently manage assigned projects, priorities, and deadlines.

*Communicate proactively with our Client Success Manager and bookkeeping team regarding missing information, deadlines, and outstanding questions.

*Maintain accurate project status and documentation in our practice management systems.

*Follow established quality control procedures and identify opportunities to improve them.

*Develop and refine standard operating procedures, templates, and internal workflows.

*Identify opportunities to streamline tax preparation, research, projections, and compliance through technology and automation.

*Participate in team meetings, training, and professional development.



EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS REQUIRED:

*Minimum 5 years of , including substantial experience preparing individual and business returns. Candidates with 8–12 years of experience are especially encouraged to apply.

*Extensive experience preparing US federal individual and business tax returns, including Forms 1040, 1120, 1120-S, and 1065.

*Proficiency in using Tax software.  Experience in Intuit ProConnect Tax Online is a huge advantage.

*Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including complex calculations, reconciliations, and financial analysis.

*Experience working with US accounting firms and/or US-based clients.

*Strong working knowledge of US federal tax law and relevant state tax requirements.

*Experience with pass-through entities, shareholder and partner basis, business structures, and individual tax considerations.

*Ability to prepare tax returns independently, evaluate technical accuracy, and identify matters requiring further research or review.

*Strong research and analytical skills, including the ability to interpret tax guidance and document conclusions.

*Experience preparing tax projections and supporting tax planning recommendations.

*Familiarity with US payroll processing, payroll tax compliance, and accounting reconciliations.

*Excellent written and spoken English.

*Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple deadlines.

*Reliable high-speed internet, a suitable remote workspace, and backup equipment/connectivity.



Nice to have:

*Philippine Certified Public Accountant (CPA) credential.

*Active US Enrolled Agent (EA) credential.

*Experience with a Big Four accounting firm or established US public accounting firm.

*Advanced experience in tax planning for closely held businesses, high-income individuals, and multientity structures.

*Experience preparing multistate individual and business tax returns.

*Experience conducting technical reviews of returns prepared by other accountants.

*Familiarity with tax workflow automation, AI-assisted research, and accounting technology.



WE’RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO

*Thinks beyond the return. You understand that tax preparation is only one part of effective tax planning. You’re naturally curious about opportunities to improve a client’s overall financial position.

*Takes ownership. You don’t need someone constantly checking your progress. You anticipate deadlines, resolve problems, and follow through.

*Has excellent technical judgment. You’re confident in your expertise, but you know when to research, ask questions, or challenge an assumption.

*Loves the details. You enjoy untangling complicated financial records, finding discrepancies, and getting the numbers exactly right.

*Communicates clearly. You can explain complicated tax matters in straightforward language and provide organized, actionable recommendations.

*Enjoys improving systems. You’re always looking for a more accurate, efficient, or effective way to complete work.

*Values collaboration and independence. You enjoy being part of a small, capable team where your contributions matter.

*Takes work seriously without taking yourself too seriously. You care about excellence, enjoy what you do, and believe there’s more to life than work.



Tech Requirements:

*Computer - at least i5 or equivalent with 8gb RAM

*Internet Speed - At least 50 MBPS Download speed



Job Type: Full-time

Schedule:   Monday–Friday, 6:00 AM–2:00 PM US Central standard time // 8PM to 4AM Philippine Time

Salary Range: Php 160,
,000 monthly, Depending on experience



Full-Time Performance Bonuses:



We believe exceptional professionals deserve competitive compensation, meaningful

opportunities to grow, and a work environment that supports their lives outside the

Office.



*Our full-time team bonuses include:

Generous Paid Time Off: Accrues at 21 paid days annually, increasing to 30 days after three years.

*Extended Weekends: One four-day weekend each month during our off-season, separate from regular PTO.

* Quarterly Profit-Sharing Bonuses: Opportunities to share in the firm’s financial success.

*Health Benefits: Health insurance reimbursement for you and your family.

* In-Home Support: Monthly allowance toward household assistance or childcare.

* Internet Allowance: Monthly reimbursement for reliable home internet.

* 13th-Month Bonus: Additional month’s compensation after one year.

 *Work-Life Balance: A consistent 40-hour workweek with no mandatory overtime, including during tax season.

 *Professional Growth: Opportunities to deepen your tax strategy expertise, expand your responsibilities, and advance within our growing firm.



Application Instruction:

Fill out this form:

I'm looking for an experienced creative strategist and direct response copywriter to work alongside me in building and scaling DTC e-commerce brands.



I'm currently in a product testing phase where we're consistently researching and launching new products until we find something we can scale. Once we find a winner, the goal is for you to transition into a full-time role and eventually take ownership of the brand's creative strategy.



**What you'll initially be doing:**

- Writing conversion-focused product page and listicle/advertorial copy, structured section by section.

- Writing video ad scripts and creative briefs.

- Working directly with me and our video editor to bring these concepts to life.



I'll be handling the actual website building and media buying myself.



**Once we transition into a full-time role:**



- Analysing creative performance and understanding why certain ads work and others don't.

- Developing new concepts, angles, scripts and iterations of winning creatives.

- Continuously researching and deepening your understanding of our market and customers.

- Taking ownership of the brand's creative direction and working directly with our creative team.



**Who I'm looking for:**



- Previous experience working with DTC e-commerce brands.

- Strong direct response copywriting skills.

- A deep understanding of consumer psychology and marketing fundamentals.

- Familiarity with Eugene Schwartz's Breakthrough Advertising principles, including awareness levels, market sophistication and mass desire.

- Experience writing advertorials, product pages and video ad scripts.

- Comfortable using AI tools to improve research, workflows and speed of execution.

- Someone who can think independently, work quickly and produce high-quality work without getting caught up in perfectionism.



I'm not looking for someone who simply completes tasks or relies on AI to do their thinking for them. I want someone who genuinely understands marketing, enjoys what they do and proactively educates themselves to continuously get better.



I want someone who takes ownership, brings their own ideas to the table and understands WHY we're doing something rather than just doing it.



**Compensation:**

- Ongoing product testing: $200 USD per product launch.

- Full-time creative strategist: $3,000 USD/month, with the opportunity to earn additional performance-based bonuses as we scale.



Initially, the goal is to launch new products every 1–3 days, so speed and efficiency are important.



I'm looking to build a long-term working relationship with someone who wants to grow alongside the business and be part of building something from scratch.



**To apply, please include:**



1. A brief introduction and your previous experience with DTC e-commerce brands.

2. Examples of product page copy, advertorials and video ad scripts you've personally written.

3. A brief explanation of how you approach researching a completely new product and identifying marketing angles.

4. What you've been doing recently to improve your skills as a marketer.



Please keep your application genuine and personal. I'm more interested in understanding how you think than reading a generic AI-generated application.

title: Construction Estimator & Drafter (Decks/Pergolas) – Excel + SketchUp – 24hr Quote Turnaround
description:
WHO WE ARE

Clever Craft Carpentry is a fast-growing outdoor living builder in Sydney, Australia. We design and build premium composite decks, pergolas, balustrades and cladding. We're scaling hard and need one sharp person to own our estimating and quoting engine.



THE ROLE IN ONE SENTENCE

You turn my site walkthrough video into plans, a costed estimate and a client-ready quote. Most jobs need to be done in under 24 hours, and none can take more than 48.



WHAT YOU'LL DO ON EVERY JOB

1. Watch my site video and listen to the recording. I show measurements, levels, access and existing structures, and talk through the full scope out loud.

2. Do the take-off: framing, decking boards, fixings, footings, posts, beams, balustrade, cladding, waterproofing etc.

3. Build the estimate in our Excel costing template: materials, labour, extras, margin. The template does the profit maths. You make sure every line is right.

4. Draw the plans in SketchUp (or AutoCAD): plan view, elevations, key dimensions, framing layout, plus a simple 3D view for the client.

5. Write the Scope of Works in plain English, listing clearly what's included and excluded.

6. Put it all together in our quote presentation template, ready for my review.

7. Flag anything unclear or risky instead of guessing.



TURNAROUND

- Standard jobs: under 24 hours

- Complex jobs: maximum 48 hours

Speed wins us jobs. This is the most important part of the role.



YOU WON'T START FROM SCRATCH

You'll get our Excel costing template, quote presentation template, supplier price list and full training on our systems and products.



HOW THE ROLE GROWS

Stage 1 – Paid trial (PER JOB)

- Small jobs (simple deck or single pergola)

- Standard jobs (deck + balustrade/steps, or pergola + deck)

- Complex jobs (multi-level, pool decks, curved designs, cladding packages)

- Includes one round of revisions per job

- Paid weekly via Wise, every Friday, no delays

- Current volume: around 3 quote packages per week, growing quickly. Our target is 20 per week.



Stage 2 – Full time

Pass the trial and you move to a full-time monthly salary, handle all our quotes, and take on:

- Ordering materials for won jobs

-
ing suppliers for pricing, availability and delivery

- Keeping our materials price list up to date

- Growing into Head of Estimating as the team grows



YOU MUST HAVE

- Proven experience in construction estimating or quantity take-offs (show us examples)

- Strong SketchUp and/or AutoCAD skills

- Strong Excel (formulas, not just typing numbers in)

- Excellent written English and the ability to understand an Australian accent on video and audio

- Extreme attention to detail. One missed item can wipe out the profit on a job.

- Reliable internet and availability that overlaps with Sydney business hours



BIG BONUS IF YOU HAVE

- Experience with decks, pergolas, timber framing or residential builders

- Knowledge of Australian building standards (AS 1684, NCC) or Australian suppliers

- Experience with composite decking (Trex, ModWood, Millboard, NewTechWood etc.)

- Experience
ing suppliers or handling purchase orders



HOW TO APPLY (applications that skip these steps are deleted)

1. Start your application with the words "24 HOURS" so we know you read this.

2. Attach or link 2–3 examples of plans you've drawn and 1 estimate or take-off you've done.

3. In 3–5 sentences, tell us what you would do if a measurement was missing from the site video.

4. Record a short Loom video (max 2 mins) introducing yourself and your experience.



Shortlisted applicants will do a PAID test: a real site video turned into plans + estimate.

title: AI-Native App Developer & Creative Technologist
description:
PhenomenalM | Remote | Full-Time



We're building something that doesn't fit neatly into an existing category.



Reality Control Panel™ is high end, high standards,  interactive digital experience designed to fundamentally change how people engage with their lives and evolve their identity. We are combining immersive design, artificial intelligence, gamification, interactive experiences, audio, and unconventional approaches to digital product development. Think life coaching, meets quantum physics, with NLP and hypnotherapy teachings all wrapped up into a gamified app. 



Our vision is to reach 100,000 humans worldwide.



We've already built the foundation of the product using AI-powered development tools. Now, we're looking for someone who can step into what we've created, expand what's possible, and accelerate its evolution alongside our leadership team.



### Who we're looking for



We are not looking for a conventional software developer.



We're looking for a creative builder with technical depth. Someone who has embraced AI-native development and understands how dramatically artificial intelligence has changed what is possible, how quickly products can be built, and who can participate in building them.



You might describe yourself as a vibe coder, creative technologist, AI-native developer, or product builder.



You have the technical skills to understand, troubleshoot, strengthen, and evolve an existing codebase, but your greatest strength is your ability to turn imaginative concepts into working digital experiences.



You don't need every detail mapped out before you begin. You enjoy exploring ideas, experimenting, building prototypes, and discovering possibilities that weren't obvious at the beginning.



You're excited by evolution rather than attached to your original creation.



### What you'll be doing



**Evolve an existing AI-built application**



- Take ownership of understanding the existing application, codebase, infrastructure, and functionality.

- Identify opportunities to strengthen the technical foundation without unnecessarily rebuilding what already works.

- Rapidly develop, test, and implement new features using AI-powered development workflows.

- Improve the application's performance, reliability, security, and scalability as the user base grows.



**Co-create extraordinary digital experiences**



- Work directly with leadership to translate ambitious, unconventional ideas into functional experiences.

- Bring forward creative ideas and technological possibilities we may not have considered.

- Explore immersive interfaces, personalization, AI-generated experiences, gamification, animations, audio, and interactive functionality.

- Prototype ideas quickly so we can experience them rather than spend weeks discussing them.

- Push beyond conventional app design and functionality.



**Build an AI-native development ecosystem**



- Leverage AI coding agents and emerging technologies to accelerate development.

- Establish intelligent workflows that reduce unnecessary manual coding and repetitive work.

- Maintain clear project instructions, documentation, version control, and development standards.

- Create an environment where leadership can continue contributing to and evolving the application using AI tools.

- Ensure collaborative changes can be made without compromising the stability of the live product.



**Support the evolution of the product**



- Troubleshoot issues and implement improvements quickly.

- Review user behavior, product feedback, and technical performance to identify opportunities.

- Experiment, iterate, and evolve features based on what we discover.

- Maintain appropriate testing, security, privacy, deployment, and recovery practices.



### Your technical capabilities



We're interested in what you can create, not simply how many years you've been coding.



You should have practical experience with:



- AI-assisted development tools such as Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, or comparable platforms.

- Building and deploying functional web applications.

- Front-end and back-end development fundamentals.

- APIs, databases, authentication, and third-party integrations.

- GitHub, version control, and collaborative development.

- Cloud hosting and application deployment.

- Debugging and reviewing AI-generated code.

- Responsive interfaces and exceptional user experience design.

- Application security, data privacy, and scalable architecture.



Experience with AI integrations, gamification, interactive animations, personalized experiences, or immersive digital environments is particularly valuable.



### How you operate



- **Creative first.** You're energized by possibilities and extraordinary ideas.

- **Fast-moving.** You prefer creating a working prototype to spending unnecessary time discussing hypotheticals.

- **Resourceful.** When you encounter something unfamiliar, you know how to use AI and other resources to figure it out.

- **Adaptable.** You can change direction without becoming frustrated or attached to previous work.

- **Collaborative.** You enjoy building alongside visionary, nontraditional product creators.

- **Proactive.** You bring ideas and possibilities forward without waiting to be asked.

- **Technically responsible.** You understand the difference between rapid experimentation and releasing something unreliable into production.

- **Continuously evolving.** You're genuinely excited about emerging AI capabilities and are actively experimenting with them.



### This role is probably not for you if:



- You require exhaustive specifications before you can begin building.

- You prefer rigid development cycles over rapid experimentation.

- You believe traditional coding is inherently superior to AI-assisted development.

- You become attached to your code, design decisions, or original ideas.

- You enjoy the technical mechanics of development more than the experience you're creating.

- You introduce unnecessary complexity instead of finding elegant solutions.

- You want exclusive control over the codebase or development process.



### Engagement structure



This is beginning with a paid collaborative 30 day trial moving into full time work.



We are not looking to build a traditional development department or create permanent dependency on an individual developer. We are looking for an exceptional creative and technical partner who can accelerate the product's evolution, strengthen its foundation, and establish an ecosystem that supports continued innovation.



### How to apply



Please provide:



1. Links to applications or digital experiences you've personally built using AI-assisted development.

3. An example of something you've created that pushed beyond conventional application design.

4. An example of how you've taken over, understood, and improved an existing codebase.

5. Your availability, monthly rate, and preferred project-based compensation structure.

6. A short video introducing yourself and answering:



   - What excites you most about what's becoming possible with AI-native development?

   - How would you approach collaborating with a nontechnical product visionary who is actively building alongside you using AI?

We're much more interested in seeing what you've created, how you think, and how quickly you can turn possibilities into reality than reviewing a traditional résumé.



**Show us what you can build.**

title: Education Program Manager (Online Property Education)
description:
Role at a Glance



- Position title: Education Program Manager

- Team: Online education course (property renovation and investment)

- Reports to: Chief Operations Officer, with a direct line to the Director on strategy

- Location: Remote, Philippines

- Engagement: Independent contractor, full-time (40 hours per week). Starts part-time (20 hours per week) during training and probation, then moves to full-time.

- Working hours: Monday to Friday, within Melbourne business hours (8am - 5pm AEST/AEDT / 5am - 2pm PHT), plus one weekly evening group call (Wednesday, 7:00 PM Melbourne, which is 4:00 PM in the Philippines)

- Start date: As soon as possible

- Pay: USD $8–10 per hour, depending on experience





About Us

We are an Australian property investment business. We renovate and invest in residential property with our money partners, and we help clients buy the right property. Our online education course teaches everyday investors how to invest in property and add value through renovation. Our team works remotely across Australia, the Philippines, Vietnam and Indonesia.

We celebrate differences. We value different points of view, open communication and respectful debate, because better ideas come from people who think differently. We use AI tools and clear systems every day so the whole team can work smarter.







About the Role

This is a management role. You will lead the team that runs our online property education course and make sure the work gets done: on time, to a high standard and without anything falling through the cracks. You will set priorities, keep people accountable, solve problems as they come up, and keep the Director clearly informed every week.

The two things that matter most in this role are communication and execution. We are looking for someone who is clear and direct with people, follows through on every commitment, and gets things done.







Key Responsibilities

- Team leadership: Lead and manage the program team, including operations, student support and coaching support. Set clear weekly priorities, hold regular one-on-ones, and give feedback early and kindly.

- Execution: Turn plans into action. Break work into tasks with one owner and a due date in ClickUp, follow up until each one is done, and remove blockers so the team can keep moving.

- Weekly team meeting: Run the weekly team meeting, keep it short and focused, and make sure every decision and action is written down and followed up.

- Communication: Be the single point of contact between the program team and Marketing, the website team, Finance and Admin, and the Director. Keep everyone working to the same plan and dates.

- Program delivery: Make sure the online course runs smoothly every week: student onboarding, the weekly group call, student support and the online community.

- Problem solving: Spot issues early, d
 what to do, and fix them, whether that is a delayed task, a student complaint, a payment problem or a website issue.

- Weekly update: Send the Director a short update every Friday: what got done, what is behind, the key numbers, and decisions needed.

- SOPs and systems: Write and keep current the SOPs the team needs, so work is done the same way every time and new team members can get up to speed quickly.

- Hiring and onboarding: Help hire, onboard and train new team members as the program grows.

- Compliance: Make sure the team stays on the general education side: no personal financial or credit advice, no income promises, and policies applied as written.







What Success Looks Like

- Clear ownership: Every part of the program has an owner, and core SOPs are written, by day 30

- Execution: Agreed weekly priorities delivered on time, and overdue tasks followed up within 2 business days

- Communication: Friday update sent to the Director every week; no surprises on delays or problems

- Team: Regular one-on-ones held, and every team member knows their priorities each week

- Program delivery: Weekly group calls, onboarding and student support run on schedule







Skills and Experience

Must have

- Based in the Philippines

- 3 or more years managing or leading a team, ideally remote

- At least 1 year of experience in an education, coaching or online course program

- Strong experience in a similar or relevant industry, such as property, real estate, online business or customer operations

- Strong execution skills: a track record of getting things done, on time, with little supervision

- Excellent written and spoken English; clear, warm and direct with team members and students

- Organised and confident with tools such as ClickUp and Google Workspace

- Available full-time in Melbourne business hours, plus the Wednesday evening call (part-time during training and probation)





Nice to have

- 3 or more years managing an online course, coaching or education program

- Experience in e-commerce

- Interest in property investing or renovation

- Experience with membership, payment or
 tools such as Memberstack, Stripe or Kit

- Experience managing an online community, such as a
 group

Tools You Will Use

ClickUp (tasks and projects), Slack (team chat), Google Workspace 
, documents and meetings), Jibble (time tracking), Claude (AI assistant), Zoom (group calls), plus our membership, payment and
 tools.







How We Work

- Remote first: We work across time zones, so we write things down and keep our tasks updated in ClickUp.

- Daily rhythm: Clock in with Jibble, join the daily AI Hour and send your EOD report before you log off.

- Weekly check-ins: Join the weekly all-hands meeting and a weekly 1:1 with your manager.

title: Work From Home Merchandise Allocator (Fashion Retail) | 6am to 2pm PHT, Mon to Fri
description:
SALARY

US$270 per week.



HOURS

9:00am to 5:00pm Sydney time (Australian Eastern Time), Monday to Friday.

That is 6:00am to 2:00pm Philippine time now (Australian daylight saving), and 7:00am to 3:00pm PHT from April when daylight saving ends. No night shift.



ABOUT THE ROLE



An established Australian women's fashion brand, selling through its own retail stores and online, is hiring a Merchandise Allocator who owns allocation and replenishment day to day.



This is not an "upload and execute" role. You must understand and explain the drivers behind every allocation: how you seed a new collection, when consolidations make sense, and how you manage priorities with your Planning Manager. If you cannot walk through those fundamentals clearly, this role is not a fit.



You will report to the Planning Manager and work from home on Sydney hours.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Own model stock and replenishment across retail stores and ecommerce in the brand's retail ERP / merchandise system (training is available if you have used a similar system)

- Allocate new seasonal collections from first drop through early replenishment, using store tiering, capacity, size profiles, last-season performance and planned intake, not gut feel alone

- Run ongoing allocations, store transfers and consolidations using rate of sale, sell-through, weeks cover, stock on hand, inventory age and broken size runs

- Spot and act on consolidation triggers early (trading data and seasonal / calendar events), and bring a clear recommendation to the Planning Manager rather than waiting to be told

- Turn weekly trade into actions: what to move, replenish, consolidate or mark down, and why

- Prepare weekly and monthly sales, stock and allocation reports that lead with insights and recommendations

- Balance warehouse deadlines, store replenishment pressure and manager requests without dropping the ball, and communicate trade-offs upwards

- Improve and automate manual reports and models where you can



MUST-HAVES



- Fluent spoken and written English (non-negotiable)

- Hands-on experience with a retail ERP or merchandise planning / allocation system (for example AP21 / Apparel21, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, Cin7, Retail Pro, JDA / Oracle, or similar)

- Proven stock allocation experience with a fashion retailer, apparel brand or department store

- At least 1 year as an Allocator, Merchandise Assistant or similar inventory / allocation role in fashion, apparel or retail, with exposure beyond pure execution (trade analysis, recommendations, consolidations or markdowns)

- Can clearly explain how you approach allocating a new collection (inputs, sequence, hold-back for replenishment, hero vs slow styles)

- Can name the data points and seasonal events that trigger consolidations, with a real example

- Can manage upwards: prioritise under pressure and give the Planning Manager a decision-ready view

- Strong grasp of retail metrics: sell-through, weeks cover, stock turn, rate of sale, inventory age

- Advanced Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, XLOOKUP / VLOOKUP, formulas, reporting). Shortlisted candidates complete a short Excel analysis task

- Able to work independently, own outcomes end to end, and work Mon to Fri, 9:00am to 5:00pm Sydney time



HIGHLY REGARDED



- Building or refining store tiering, capacity or size-profile frameworks

- Allocating across both retail and ecommerce

- Automation skills (VBA, Google Apps Script or similar)

- Junior Planner or merchandise planning experience

- A passion for fashion and retail



THE RIGHT PERSON



You do not just push stock. You can explain the commercial logic: how a new collection gets seeded, what forces a consolidation, and how you protect bestsellers while clearing aged inventory. You read the numbers, recommend the next move, and keep your manager informed when priorities collide. You look for ways to improve the process rather than wait to be told.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application subject line with ALLOCATOR-27 so we know you read the ad. Applications without it, or that skip the questions, will not be reviewed.



1. Attach your updated CV.

2. Answer all three questions below in your application.

3. Confirm your earliest start date and that you can work Mon to Fri, 9:00am to 5:00pm Sydney time (6:00am to 2:00pm PHT now, 7:00am to 3:00pm PHT from April), at US$270 per week.



REQUIRED QUESTIONS



1. A new seasonal collection has just landed in the warehouse and needs first allocation across retail stores and ecommerce before it goes live. Walk us through how you would approach that allocation from scratch. Cover at least: which data and inputs you would pull before you allocate a single unit (for example last season sell-through by store/style/size, store tiering or capacity, size curves, planned intake, ecommerce demand); how you would d
 depth by store vs holding back for replenishment; how you would treat hero styles vs slow movers; and what you would check in week one after the drop. Do not give a generic "I would look at sales and send stock" answer. Name the metrics and the sequence.



2. What events or data points would make you recommend consolidating stock (pulling from some stores / channels into others, or back to DC)? Give specific examples across both trading data (for example weeks cover, rate of sale, sell-through, inventory age, broken size runs, stockouts elsewhere) and calendar / seasonal events (for example end of season, promo window, new collection intake, store refit or closure). For one real example from your past role, say what you saw, what you recommended, who you took it to, and what happened.



3. It is Monday morning Sydney time. You have: (a) a new collection allocation that must leave the warehouse today, (b) three stores chasing urgent replenishment on bestsellers that are stocked out, and (c) your Planning Manager has asked for a clear recommendation on consolidating aged winter stock before a promotion next week, for a catch-up in two hours. How do you prioritise, what do you do first, what do you defer, and exactly how do you communicate upwards so the manager has a decision-ready view without you dropping the urgent store or warehouse work?



Fluent English is required.
