title: Linkedin Outbound Setter
description:
💰 $500 Signing Bonus | Hourly Pay + Uncapped Performance Incentives



Turn Conversations Into Business Opportunities



Are you a strong communicator who enjoys connecting with people, building relationships, and creating opportunities?



Demand Acquisition is expanding its business development team and looking for driven individuals to help us connect with business owners who want to grow their companies.



We specialize in helping businesses acquire more customers through marketing strategies, lead generation systems, sales processes, and customer acquisition solutions.



We're looking for someone who can take initiative, communicate professionally, and consistently turn prospect conversations into qualified sales opportunities.



This position is ideal for someone who wants to develop valuable skills in B2B sales, marketing, lead generation, and business development while earning based on performance.



No advanced experience is required. We provide the training, systems, resources, and support needed to succeed.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



Your responsibility is to generate interest, educate potential customers, nurture relationships, and schedule qualified appointments for our sales team.



Find & Connect With Business Owners



- Research and identify potential business clients.

- Prospect through LinkedIn, Instagram,
, and other approved platforms.

- Send personalized outreach messages and initiate professional conversations.

- Generate interest in Demand Acquisition's services.



Manage Conversations & Follow-Ups



- Respond to incoming messages and inquiries.

- Follow up with prospects who haven't responded.

- Maintain consistent communication with interested business owners.

- Re-engage prospects who may need additional information before making a decision.



Educate & Nurture Potential Clients



- Share educational YouTube videos, case studies, and business resources.

- Explain our services and how our customer acquisition systems work.

- Invite interested prospects into our free SKOOL community.

- Help prospects understand the problems we solve before speaking with our sales team.



Qualify Leads & Schedule Appointments



- Ask questions to understand each prospect's business and objectives.

- Identify serious business owners who may benefit from our services.

- Make follow-up calls to interested prospects when appropriate.

- Schedule qualified Zoom appointments with our sales representatives.

- Confirm appointments and help maximize attendance.



Track Your Performance



- Update prospect information and conversations in our CRM.

- Organize follow-up tasks and lead statuses.

- Maintain accurate records of daily outreach and appointments.

- Submit daily activity and performance reports.



Important: This is an appointment-setting and business development position, not a closing role. You will focus on generating, educating, nurturing, and qualifying opportunities. Our sales team is responsible for conducting sales calls and closing clients.



WHAT MAKES SOMEONE SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE?



We're looking for individuals who take pride in their work and understand that consistent execution produces results.



The ideal candidate:



- Speaks and writes English fluently.

- Has excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

- Is persistent and doesn't give up after one unanswered message.

- Has strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Is comfortable initiating conversations with business owners.

- Can follow established processes and execute instructions.

- Is coachable and actively looks for ways to improve.

- Can work independently and manage daily responsibilities.

- Is comfortable using LinkedIn and other social media platforms.



Previous experience in appointment setting, sales, telemarketing, customer service, or lead generation is helpful but not mandatory.



We value work ethic, consistency, communication, and the willingness to learn.



 REQUIRED EQUIPMENT & AVAILABILITY



- Personal computer or laptop.

- Reliable high-speed internet connection.

- Webcam and microphone.

- Quiet and professional working environment.

- Availability for a full-time, 40-hour workweek.

- Basic computer skills and familiarity with Google Sheets.



Experience with GoHighLevel or other CRM platforms is an advantage.



 ⭐️LINKEDIN IS A CORE PART OF THIS POSITION



Our business development team uses LinkedIn daily to identify and connect with business owners.



For this reason, applicants must:



- ⭐️Have an active LinkedIn account under their real identity or be willing to create and verify one before beginning training.

- Have access to their own personal LinkedIn profile.

- Be comfortable with daily professional networking and outbound messaging.

- Provide their LinkedIn profile URL when applying.



Purchased, borrowed, fake, or shared accounts are not permitted.



If you're unwilling or unable to meet these requirements, this position will not be a good fit.



WHAT WE PROVIDE



We want our team members to develop professionally while producing meaningful results.



You'll receive:



- Direct training and mentorship from company leadership.

- Established outreach scripts and prospecting strategies.

- Educational materials and training resources.

- Guidance on B2B sales, communication, and lead qualification.

- CRM systems and structured workflows.

- Ongoing feedback and performance coaching.

- Opportunities to earn additional compensation through performance.

- Opportunities for advancement as the company grows.



We're interested in building long-term working relationships with people who demonstrate commitment and strong performance.



COMPENSATION & INCENTIVES

We believe compensation should reward both consistency and measurable results.



Starting Compensation: $3 USD per hour + performance-based incentives.



Initial Training Period



During the initial training and ramp-up period, compensation includes:



- Performance-based appointment commissions.

- Additional daily, weekly, and monthly bonuses.

- Eligibility for the $500 signing bonus.

- Additional rewards for appointments that turn into paying clients.



Full-Time Position



After successfully completing training and demonstrating that you're a good fit, you'll transition into the full-time compensation structure.



This includes:



- Guaranteed hourly pay.

- Appointment commissions.

- Performance bonuses.

- Additional incentives tied to business results.



Appointment Incentives



- $15–$25+ for every qualified appointment that attends its scheduled Zoom meeting.

- $150+ additional commission when an appointment you generated converts into a closed client.



We have a good offer. Our sales team has historically converted approximately 40%+ of qualified appointments.



Experienced appointment setters have averaged approximately $1600–$2,133 USD per month.



There is additional earning potential for individuals who consistently perform at a high level.



Your results matter. The more qualified opportunities you generate and the more consistently you execute, the greater your earning potential.



OUR CULTURE & EXPECTATIONS

At Demand Acquisition, we believe in building a team around a few important principles:



- Take action quickly.

- Follow up consistently.

- Educate prospects and build trust.

- Pay attention to the details.

- Communicate openly.

- Take responsibility for your results.

- Improve your skills every day.

- Prioritize quality over unnecessary activity.



We want people who are serious about improving, developing their abilities, and contributing to a growing company.



APPLICATION PROCESS

We want to learn more about you before scheduling an interview.



Please submit the following:

1. Resume: Include a link to your resume with your employment history and relevant experience.



2. Introduction Video or Voice Recording: Introduce yourself, explain your background, and tell us why you're interested in joining Demand Acquisition.



3. Communication Skills: Briefly describe your experience communicating with customers, business owners, or potential clients.



4. Persistence: Explain how you would handle a prospect who doesn't respond to your first or second outreach message.



5. LinkedIn Profile: Provide the URL to your personal LinkedIn account.



6. Attention to Detail: Include the phrase "EDUCATE WITH VIDEO" somewhere in your application.



Please follow all application instructions. Incomplete applications may not be considered.



We are actively reviewing candidates and looking to bring new team members on board as soon as possible.



 🎉 YOUR $500 SIGNING BONUS

We offer a $500 signing bonus to reward individuals who commit to completing our initial training program.



Here's how it works:



- Earn $20 per week during the first eight weeks of initial training, in addition to performance compensation.

- Complete the full eight-week training period successfully.

- Receive the remaining $340 after successfully completing training.



The full $500 bonus is contingent upon successful completion of the eight-week training program.



We're looking for people who want more than just another job. We want individuals who are motivated to develop professionally, build valuable business skills, and grow alongside our company.



If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.



Demand Acquisition is an equal opportunity employer committed to hiring a diverse and talented workforce.

title: Operations Manager
description:
Operations Manager



Wambold Properties | Remote | Full-Time Preferred



About Us



Wambold Properties is a growing boutique interior design and short-term rental management company serving clients across the United States.



We are seeking an experienced, highly organized, and entrepreneurial Operations Manager to work directly with our founder, oversee our growing team, streamline business operations, and support continued company growth.



This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who enjoys developing people, building systems, solving problems, and contributing across multiple areas of a growing business.



Key Responsibilities



Team Management & Leadership



* Oversee daily operations across interior design, procurement, installations, property management, sales, and social media.

* Manage team workloads, schedules, priorities, performance, and accountability.

* Ensure team members meet deadlines, communicate proactively, and fulfill their responsibilities.

* Lead team meetings and individual check-ins.

* Identify staffing needs, workload imbalances, and opportunities to improve productivity.

* Provide hands-on support across departments when additional assistance is needed.

* Independently resolve routine operational challenges and escalate significant concerns with recommended solutions.

* Support the development of employee performance standards and management processes.



Recruitment, Onboarding & Training



* Assist with recruiting, interviewing, and evaluating candidates across all departments.

* Take ownership of new hire onboarding and training.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Location: Work-from-home (Independent Contractor)

We are looking for an experienced Marketing Manager to join an established UK-based business.



As the business continues to grow, it is looking to bring its marketing activity in-house and appoint an experienced Marketing Manager who can take ownership of its marketing across website management, digital advertising, SEO,
 campaigns, social media, customer data and marketing collateral.



About the Role



We are seeking an experienced and commercially focused Marketing Manager to take ownership of the business’s day-to-day marketing activities and help drive measurable business growth.



This is a hands-on, varied role suited to an experienced marketing all-rounder who is comfortable managing multiple marketing channels independently with light oversight.



The successful candidate will work closely with the Sales Manager and will be responsible for planning, delivering and reporting on marketing initiatives designed to increase customer retention, grow existing customer spend, generate new leads, build brand awareness in new areas and support the sales team.



A significant part of the role will also involve bringing website, design and digital marketing work currently handled externally into the internal team.



Main Priorities



The main priorities for this role are:



Lead Generation



Finding and attracting new prospective customers.



Creating marketing activities that generate measurable leads and enquiries.



Promoting the Brand



Increasing awareness among prospective and existing customers.



Making sure the brand is visible and consistently represented across marketing channels.



Website Improvement



Improving the website so that when prospects and customers look up the business, it communicates the right message.



Improving content, structure, customer journey and conversion opportunities.



The successful candidate must also be confident and experienced in creating and managing e-shots, social media posts and website improvements, as these will be key ongoing responsibilities within the role.



Key Duties & Responsibilities



Website & E-Commerce



Manage and update WordPress and WooCommerce websites.

CRM, Customer Data & Segmentation

Maintain accurate marketing contact information.



Manage marketing opt-ins and help ensure data remains compliant.



Create and maintain targeted mailing lists for marketing campaigns.



Keep customer segmentation and marketing data current.



Use Excel or Google Sheets confidently for data cleaning and categorisation.



The business currently has approximately 10,000 customer records requiring improved categorisation and segmentation, making strong data-management skills an important part of the role.



Paid Advertising & SEO

Manage and optimise Google Business Profiles, support local SEO strategies, and develop location-based marketing campaigns to improve visibility and brand awareness in existing and new service areas.



Manage Meta advertising campaigns.



Monitor campaign targeting, budgets and performance.



Carry out on-page SEO.



Conduct keyword research and optimise website content.



Monitor organic search performance.



Use Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console to track results.



Provide recommendations based on campaign and website performance.

Plan and deliver targeted
 marketing campaigns.

Create and manage automated or drip
 sequences.



Support WhatsApp marketing campaigns where required.



Prepare product, service and promotional campaigns for different customer segments.



Monitor open rates, click-through rates, leads and campaign effectiveness.

Create and publish content across LinkedIn,

Create graphics and campaign assets.

Graphic Design & Marketing Collateral

Create
 marketing templates.



Update and maintain catalogues.



Produce promotional offer sheets.

Measure website traffic and conversions.



Monitor campaign performance and cost per lead.



Support the sales team with marketing collateral, campaigns and qualified prospects.

Experience with CRM and

Google Ads

Canva

Excel / Google Sheets

 marketing platforms



Meta Business Suite



LinkedIn,

CRM or ERP platforms



Experience with Syrinx would be advantageous but is not essential.



Key Success Factors



Success in this role will include:



Taking ownership of the business’s existing marketing activity.



Maintaining consistent and commercially focused marketing across all channels.



Improving the quality and segmentation of the customer database.



Increasing the number of usable marketing contacts.



Delivering targeted
 and digital campaigns.



Successfully managing Google and Meta advertising.

Progressing and completing key website improvements.



Reducing reliance on external agencies by bringing website, design and marketing activities in-house.

title: Senior PPC Manager & Brand Growth Strategist
description:
This is not a campaign-execution job. As a Senior PPC Manager you grow brands, oversee client accounts, and lead the way our team works with AI: building the tools and processes that take over repetitive work, and making sure what they produce is right. We are looking for someone who thinks, sees the bigger picture, and makes the whole team better.



🟢 About Growster ⚫️

Growster is a boutique Amazon growth agency based in Germany, founded by former aggregator brand owners. We work with 7- and 8-figure brands in the EU, UK and US. Our PPC Managers are also the account managers: they own the account and the client relationship. And we are moving our whole way of working to AI-assisted workflows that our own team designs, builds and checks.

🔘What you will do

✦Own a portfolio of brands end to end: growth, profit, margin, TACOS and the P&L, not only the ad console.

✦Go beyond bid management. Connect PPC with organic rank, listing, images, CTR, CVR, pricing, stock and promotions, and flag when the problem is not PPC at all.

✦Design and build AI-assisted tools and processes that optimize our workflows and improve the ones we already have, and get the team using them.

✦Oversee accounts with a sharp eye. Check AI output before it reaches a client or an account, correct what is wrong, and own the result.

✦Put analysis, prevention and growth ahead of busywork: spot problems before they show up in the numbers, fix the cause, and add a check so it does not happen again.

✦Lead client communication: clear, proactive and honest, including client calls, decisions and hard news. Share wins, problems and plans before the client asks.

✦Work as part of the team and raise its level: help teammates do things on their own, mentor newer PPC managers, share what you learn and build, and disagree openly and constructively. This matters as much as your own results.

🔘The person we are looking for

✦Analytical. You start from the data and you know which numbers matter.

✦High-agency. You see what needs doing and do it, without waiting to be told.

✦Holistic. You think about the whole brand, not one channel.

✦AI-sharp. You build with AI and you catch it when it is wrong.

✦Honest. You say what is really happening, to the client and to us, including your own mistakes.

✦Collaborative and coachable. You make the people around you better, and you take feedback well.

🔘Who we are not looking for

🚫Checklist-only operators who follow steps without asking why.

🚫Yes-men. We want people who push back with reasons.

🚫Siloed specialists who only look at the ad console.

🚫Vanity-metric chasers who report impressions while profit slips.

🚫People who measure their value in hours and task lists. We do not need a daily "here is everything I did" report. We need the right things done and the wrong things prevented.

🚫Relays for AI. If you pass on what an AI says without checking it, this is not the role for you: every output that reaches a client or an account is yours.

🚫Part-time or freelance arrangements. This role is full-time.

🔘What success looks like after 6 months

✦You run a portfolio of brands end to end, and the clients see measurable growth.

✦At least one AI-assisted tool or process you built is used by the whole team.

✦Problems on your accounts are caught and prevented before clients notice them.

✦Teammates and clients come to you as a trusted voice.

🔘What you bring

✦3+ years owning Amazon accounts, with growth you can prove: case studies with numbers, ideally on 7- or 8-figure brands.

✦AI workflows or tools you built (with Claude, ChatGPT, automations, scripts or sheets) that changed how you or your team work, and how you check what they produce.

✦Analytical depth: Search Query Performance, search-term and placement data, bulk files, spreadsheets, and P&L thinking (break-even ACOS, TACOS, margin).

✦Strong command of the levers around PPC: SEO and keywords, listing and image content, pricing, inventory and profitability.

✦Excellent written and spoken client communication in English.

🔘What we offer

✦Salary: $1,300 to $2,300 per month (negotiable).

✦Full-time and fully remote, with flexible hours judged on results. We need a working overlap with German business hours for team and client calls.

✦A lean team that builds and shares its own AI tools.

🔘How to apply

✦Record a 5-minute intro video (Loom or similar) covering: who you are and which role you are applying for, why Growster, and your experience (challenges, meaningful projects, where you want to grow).

✦Take the free Mensa Norway IQ test at 
 and keep a screenshot of your score. It is information we collect, never a pass or fail filter.

✦Fill in the application form at 
 and upload your resume as a PDF.

❗️About AI and writing. Some questions ask you to work with your preferred AI tool; for those, paste the whole chat, because how you steer and check the AI is what we look at. Everywhere else, write in your own words. Voice-to-text such as Wispr Flow is fine, but avoid using any grammar correction function from these tools.

✦Applications sent any other way than the form are not reviewed. It is the first test of reading instructions. Do not use any polish/grammar correction in your responses aside from AI tasks❗️

🔘Our process

✦Application (above). We review within 5 business days.

✦Audit test: an integrated audit of an anonymized account covering PPC, listing health, Search Query Performance and P&L. Materials provided.

✦Interview: you walk us through your audit as if we were the client, and we talk about how you work with a team.

✦Final interview and offer.

✦End to end this usually takes 2 to 3 weeks. No unpaid trial work on live accounts, no personality tests, no coding tests, no reference call

title: Host of YouTube Channel
description:
We run several established YouTube documentary channels (tech, history, cycling, boats, golf and more) with a solid history of videos. We are looking for hosts: each host becomes the face and voice of one channel. Several positions are open.



THE JOB



• For each video (videos are usually 30 to 60+ minutes long) you record about 5 minutes on camera: a short intro and a few short segments of 10–20 seconds, reading scripts we send you in advance.

• You record from home, in batches, when it suits you, and deliver by the agreed deadline.



REQUIREMENTS



• Clear, pleasant spoken English. Our audience is American: the closer your accent is to American, the better.

• A good microphone and clean, clear audio (no echo, no background noise). Microphone and audio quality is one of the most important factors in our evaluation.

• A quiet, tidy home or professional space, and a camera or good phone that records horizontal video in at least 1080p.

• Reliable, able to follow a script exactly and to meet deadlines.

• Exclusivity: you will be the host of our channel only. You cannot appear in, narrate or make videos for any other YouTube channel, including a personal one.

• You must never have been the face, voice or presenter of any YouTube channel before.

• Voice clone: you give your consent for us to create an AI clone of your voice, used only for that channel, to narrate the videos beyond the clips you record

title: RN with ICU, Critical Care, Emergency Training
description:
Do not apply if you are not experienced, check for our other RN positions.



# Remote Registered Nurse (RN) – Preoperative Assessment & Postoperative Clinical Triage

**Engagement Type:** Independent Contractor

**Work Location:** Remote

**Clinical Setting:** Ambulatory Surgery Centers (ASCs)

**Clinical Liaison:** Director of Clinical Operations / Director of Nursing



**POSITION SUMMARY**

We are seeking a highly experienced Registered Nurse as an independent contractor with a strong clinical background in Intensive Care (ICU), Critical Care, Emergency Department (ED), Trauma, or high-acuity Post-Anesthesia Care (PACU) to provide remote preoperative telephone assessments and postoperative clinical follow-up services for patients undergoing surgical procedures in ambulatory surgery centers.

The qualified candidate must possess advanced clinical assessment skills, exceptional critical thinking abilities, strong pharmacological knowledge, emergency response training, and the ability to recognize potential medical and surgical complications without physically examining the patient.

This is not an administrative, scheduling, or routine patient reminder position. This engagement requires an experienced clinical nurse capable of exercising independent nursing judgment, identifying surgical risk factors, recognizing acute patient deterioration, and initiating appropriate clinical escalation.



**SCOPE OF CONTRACTED SERVICES**

**1. Preoperative Clinical Assessment**

- Conduct comprehensive preoperative telephone assessments.

- Obtain and review medical and surgical histories.

- Perform medication reconciliation and review allergies.

- Identify medical comorbidities and potential anesthesia-related risks.

- Evaluate patients against established ASC patient selection and admission criteria.

- Identify medications requiring perioperative management, including anticoagulants, antiplatelets, GLP-1 medications, insulin, and opioids.

- Communicate medication instructions according to approved protocols and provider orders.

- Review laboratory results, diagnostic studies, EKGs, history and physical examinations, and medical clearances.

- Identify abnormal, missing, or incomplete clinical documentation.

- Assess cardiovascular, pulmonary, neurological, renal, hepatic, and endocrine risk factors.

- Identify obstructive sleep apnea, obesity, airway concerns, bleeding disorders, previous anesthesia complications, recent infections, hospitalizations, and functional limitations.

- Recognize conditions requiring additional medical evaluation or consideration of a higher-acuity surgical setting.

- Escalate clinical concerns to the anesthesiologist, surgeon, or designated clinical personnel.

- Track outstanding clinical requirements and verify appropriate resolution before surgery.



**2. Preoperative Patient Education**

- Provide individualized preoperative instructions.

- Reinforce fasting requirements and medication instructions.

- Educate patients regarding surgical preparation and anticipated recovery.

- Confirm transportation arrangements and responsible adult supervision following discharge.

- Identify postoperative home support and potential discharge barriers.

- Utilize teach-back techniques to confirm patient understanding.

- Address patient questions and concerns within the RN scope of practice.

- Document patient education and identified barriers to compliance.



**3. Postoperative Clinical Assessment and Follow-Up**

- Conduct postoperative telephone assessments within established facility timeframes.

- Evaluate patient recovery following anesthesia and surgical intervention.

- Perform focused clinical assessments based on the surgical procedure and patient-specific risk factors.

- Assess pain severity and effectiveness of prescribed pain management.

- Assess mental status, respiratory symptoms, cardiovascular symptoms, and medication tolerance.

- Assess patient-reported surgical site condition, bleeding, drainage, swelling, and signs of infection.

- Evaluate nausea, vomiting, hydration, nutritional intake, urinary retention, and bowel function.

- Assess patient-reported mobility, functional status, and neurovascular symptoms.

- Identify potential postoperative complications requiring immediate or timely medical intervention.

- Reinforce discharge instructions and postoperative precautions.

- Coordinate additional follow-up with the surgeon or appropriate healthcare provider.

- Document unsuccessful contact attempts and initiate follow-up according to facility policy.



**4. Clinical Triage and Emergency Recognition**

- Demonstrate advanced clinical judgment when assessing patients remotely.

- Recognize signs and symptoms of myocardial infarction, acute coronary syndrome, pulmonary embolism, deep vein thrombosis, stroke, respiratory compromise, and opioid-related adverse events.

- Recognize postoperative hemorrhage, sepsis, anaphylaxis, hypoglycemia, hyperglycemia, acute neurovascular compromise, compartment syndrome, and acute changes in mental status.

- Determine the appropriate urgency and level of clinical escalation.

- Direct patients to activate emergency medical services or call 911 when clinically indicated.

- Recognize when immediate emergency department evaluation is warranted.

- Verify the patient's physical location and callback information when emergency intervention is required.

- Initiate emergency escalation without delaying care while awaiting provider response.

- Coordinate urgent communication with surgeons, anesthesiologists, and onsite clinical personnel.

- Utilize SBAR communication when reporting clinical concerns.

- Ensure closed-loop communication and document the disposition of identified clinical concerns.



**5. Clinical Documentation and Regulatory Compliance**

- Maintain accurate, complete, and timely electronic medical record documentation.

- Document clinical assessments, patient-reported symptoms, nursing interventions, patient education, provider communications, and clinical disposition.

- Document the limitations of telephone-based assessments when applicable.

- Comply with applicable nursing licensure requirements, CMS Conditions for Coverage, accreditation standards, HIPAA, and facility policies.

- Maintain patient confidentiality and secure handling of protected health information (PHI).

- Support medical record audits and clinical documentation improvement activities.

- Immediately report patient safety concerns, privacy i
, and security breaches.



**6. Quality Assessment and Performance Improvement (QAPI)**

- Identify and report adverse events, near misses, and potential patient safety concerns.

- Identify and report day-of-surgery cancellations and incomplete preoperative assessments.

- Identify and report unplanned hospital admissions and emergency department visits.

- Identify and report postoperative complications and potential surgical site infections.

- Identify postoperative pain management concerns and patient education deficiencies.

- Track preoperative and postoperative telephone assessment completion rates.

- Provide clinical information supporting quality improvement activities, i
 reviews, and corrective action initiatives.



**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

- Graduate of an accredited or appropriately recognized registered nursing program.

- Current, active, unrestricted California Registered Nurse license for clinical nursing services provided to California patients.

- Minimum of five years of registered nursing clinical experience.

- Minimum of three years of recent, direct patient care experience in ICU, CCU, CVICU, Emergency Department, Trauma, or high-acuity PACU.

- Demonstrated experience assessing and managing medically complex patients.

- Demonstrated ability to recognize acute patient deterioration and initiate appropriate emergency interventions.

- Strong knowledge of pharmacology, pathophysiology, and perioperative complications.

- Previous perioperative, surgical, or ASC experience strongly preferred.

- Previous telephone triage or telehealth nursing experience preferred.

- Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) preferred.

- Exceptional verbal and written English communication skills.

- Ability to communicate effectively with patients of varying ages, backgrounds, and health literacy levels.

- Ability to independently interpret medical terminology, clinical documentation, and diagnostic findings.



**REQUIRED CERTIFICATIONS**

- Basic Life Support (BLS).

- Advanced Cardiovascular Life Support (ACLS).

- Pediatric Advanced Life Support (PALS), if applicable to the patient population served.



**PREFERRED SPECIALTY CERTIFICATIONS AND TRAINING**

- Critical Care Registered Nurse (CCRN).

- Certified Emergency Nurse (CEN).

- Certified Post Anesthesia Nurse (CPAN).

- Certified Ambulatory Perianesthesia Nurse (CAPA).

- Trauma Nursing Core Course (TNCC).

- Emergency and disaster response training.

- Telephone triage and telehealth training.



**REQUIRED CLINICAL COMPETENCIES**

- Advanced clinical assessment and critical thinking.

- Independent nursing judgment and clinical decision-making.

- Telephone-based clinical assessment and triage.

- Recognition of acute patient deterioration.

- Emergency recognition and response.

- Cardiovascular, respiratory, neurological, and neurovascular assessment.

- Perioperative risk identification.

- Pharmacology and medication reconciliation.

- Recognition of anesthesia-related and postoperative complications.

- Pain assessment and management.

- Interpretation of common laboratory and diagnostic findings.

- Patient education and health literacy assessment.

- Clinical prioritization and escalation.

- SBAR communication.

- Electronic medical record documentation.



**REMOTE SERVICE REQUIREMENTS**

- Ability to provide contracted services independently.

- Availability during mutually agreed service coverage periods aligned with United States Pacific Time.

- Dedicated, private, quiet, and secure remote workspace.

- Reliable high-speed internet connection with a minimum download speed of 100 Mbps, upload speed of 75 Mbps, and latency below 50 ms to the designated work environment.

- Reliable backup internet connection and contingency plan for power interruptions.

- Professional-quality headset with noise cancellation.

- Computer equipment meeting applicable security and technical specifications.

- Proficiency with electronic medical records and clinical software platforms.

- Ability to navigate multiple applications simultaneously while conducting patient assessments.

- Proficiency with secure telephone systems, Microsoft Office, Microsoft Teams, and remote access applications.

- Ability to independently troubleshoot basic technology and connectivity issues.

- Maintain availability and responsiveness during agreed service coverage periods.

- Immediately communicate technology failures or interruptions affecting patient care.

- Maintain continuity of patient care through appropriate clinical handoffs.



**HIPAA AND INFORMATION SECURITY**

- Execute applicable confidentiality, data protection, and Business Associate Agreements, as required.

- Maintain compliance with applicable HIPAA, privacy, cybersecurity, and information security requirements.

- Utilize only authorized devices, applications, VPN connections, and communication platforms.

- Maintain a secure work environment inaccessible to unauthorized individuals.

- Do not download, print, photograph, or store patient information on unauthorized devices.

- Do not transmit patient information through personal
, messaging applications, or unauthorized platforms.

- Do not enter patient information into unauthorized artificial intelligence (AI) applications.

- Do not utilize AI as a substitute for independent clinical assessment, nursing judgment, or clinical decision-making.

- Do not record patient conversations without required authorization and compliance with applicable law and facility policy.

- Immediately report suspected privacy or information security i
.

- Do not delegate or subcontract access to patient information or clinical responsibilities without prior written authorization and appropriate credential verification.



**PROFESSIONAL ATTRIBUTES**

- Exceptional clinical judgment and critical thinking abilities.

- Strong investigative assessment skills.

- Ability to ask appropriate follow-up questions rather than rely solely on scripted questionnaires.

- Ability to recognize inconsistencies in patient-reported information.

- Ability to remain calm, professional, and decisive during urgent clinical situations.

- Strong professional accountability and ownership of contracted responsibilities.

- Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills.

- Ability to prioritize competing clinical responsibilities.

- Ability to manage a high volume of patient assessments without compromising quality or accuracy.

- Ability to communicate confidently and professionally with physicians, anesthesiologists, nurses, patients, and caregivers.

- Ability to independently identify problems, recommend appropriate actions, and follow through to resolution.



**SCOPE OF CLINICAL AUTHORITY**

The Registered Nurse is responsible for conducting nursing assessments, identifying clinical risks, providing patient education, initiating appropriate nursing interventions, and escalating concerns to the appropriate licensed healthcare provider. The RN does not independently provide medical clearance, determine anesthesia eligibility, diagnose medical conditions, prescribe medications, or modify provider orders outside authorized protocols. Final medical and anesthesia determinations remain the responsibility of the appropriate physician or anesthesia provider.



**PRE-CONTRACT CLINICAL COMPETENCY EVALUATION**

Candidates must successfully complete a live clinical competency evaluation designed to assess independent nursing knowledge, clinical judgment, emergency recognition, communication skills, and decision-making abilities. The evaluation must be completed without AI assistance, internet searches, prepared responses, or assistance from another individual.



**INITIAL AND ONGOING COMPETENCY VERIFICATION**

- Preoperative clinical assessment.

- Postoperative telephone assessment and triage.

- Emergency symptom recognition and escalation.

- Clinical decision-making scenarios.

- Medication reconciliation and pharmacology.

- Patient selection and risk identification.

- Provider notification and closed-loop communication.

- Clinical documentation accuracy.

- Patient education.

- HIPAA and information security.

- Remote technology proficiency.

- Facility-specific clinical protocols and procedures.



Clinical services may commence only after verification of professional licensure, required certifications, documented clinical competency, completion of applicable facility orientation, and execution of required contractual and confidentiality agreements.



**INDEPENDENT CONTRACTOR ENGAGEMENT**

This opportunity is structured as an independent contractor engagement for professional nursing services. The contractor is responsible for maintaining applicable professional licensure, certifications, professional liability coverage as specified in the agreement, tax obligations, and required business registrations. Compensation, service coverage periods, deliverables, invoicing requirements, and contractual obligations will be established in a separate written Independent Contractor Agreement.

About Us



Rogers & Associates (RAACPA) is a growing U.S.-based CPA and advisory firm providing comprehensive accounting, tax preparation, strategic tax planning, and financial advisory services to businesses, professionals, high-income earners, and high-net-worth individuals.



Our mission is to deliver proactive financial and tax solutions that help our clients improve profitability, minimize tax liabilities, build wealth, and achieve long-term financial success.



We are seeking an experienced, proactive, creative, and results-driven Digital Marketing & Lead Generation Specialist to develop, manage, and execute our firm's marketing and business development initiatives.



The ideal candidate will have demonstrated experience marketing professional services to the U.S. market, generating qualified leads, managing digital marketing campaigns, and developing strategies that contribute directly to client acquisition and revenue growth.



Position Objective



Develop, implement, and manage marketing strategies that strengthen our brand, generate qualified leads, increase client engagement, and drive sustainable revenue growth.



Our primary service areas for marketing and client acquisition include:



Monthly accounting and bookkeeping services

Business tax preparation and planning

Payroll services

Financial statement reviews and compilations

Outsourced accounting and financial advisory services

Advanced tax planning and advisory services

Strategic individual tax planning for high-income and high-net-worth individuals



Key Responsibilities



1. Marketing Strategy & Campaign Management



Develop and execute comprehensive marketing strategies aligned with the firm's growth objectives.

Manage marketing projects from concept through implementation.

Monitor campaign performance and recommend improvements.

Manage marketing budgets and recommend effective resource allocation.



2. Lead Generation & Business Development



Develop and implement B2B and B2C lead generation strategies targeting the U.S. market.

Research and identify qualified prospective clients.

Develop targeted prospect lists and outreach campaigns.

Manage LinkedIn and
 lead generation campaigns.

Generate qualified leads for monthly accounting, business tax, payroll, financial statement reviews and compilations, and strategic tax advisory services.

Schedule qualified prospective client consultations with firm leadership.

Develop client referral campaigns and strategic partnership opportunities.

Identify opportunities to cross-sell additional accounting, payroll, tax planning, and advisory services to existing clients.

Track lead conversion rates and client acquisition performance.



3. CRM Management & Marketing Automation



Manage and optimize the firm's HubSpot CRM for lead generation, prospect tracking, and business development.

Develop and maintain organized prospect and client databases.

Establish lead scoring, audience segmentation, and prospect follow-up workflows.

Develop automated marketing campaigns and lead nurturing sequences.

Monitor the sales pipeline and track prospect conversion rates.

Develop processes to ensure prospective clients receive timely follow-up.

Coordinate prospect handoffs, proposal tracking, and client onboarding through Qount, the firm's practice management platform.

Identify opportunities to improve workflow efficiency between marketing, sales, and client onboarding.

Evaluate opportunities to expand the use of existing CRM and marketing automation platforms across the firm.



4.
 Marketing & Newsletters



Manage and optimize the firm's Constant Contact platform.

Develop and distribute professional client newsletters.

Create targeted
 marketing campaigns promoting the firm's accounting, tax, payroll, and advisory services.

Develop educational content in collaboration with firm leadership.

Segment
 audiences based on client profiles, industries, and service needs.

Develop automated
 campaigns and follow-up sequences.

Create client retention, referral, and re-engagement campaigns.

Maintain accurate and organized
 marketing databases.

Monitor
 engagement, open rates, click-through rates, and conversions.

Ensure marketing communications comply with applicable U.S.
 marketing and privacy requirements.



5. SEO & Website Optimization

Lead and coordinate the firm's website optimization and improvement projects.

Conduct comprehensive website and SEO audits.

Perform keyword research and develop targeted SEO strategies.

Develop and implement on-page, off-page, and local SEO strategies.

Optimize website content, service pages, and landing pages.

Improve website user experience, calls to action, and lead conversion rates.

Develop strategies to increase qualified organic website traffic.

Monitor website performance using Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console.

Manage and optimize the firm's Google Business Profile.

Develop strategies to improve online visibility and the firm's professional reputation.

Coordinate with website developers and external marketing vendors as needed.



6. Content Marketing & Brand Management

Develop professional marketing materials using Canva.

Create brochures, presentations, digital advertisements, infographics, and lead magnets.

Develop educational articles, newsletters, blogs, and social media content.

Manage the firm's LinkedIn,
, and other relevant social media platforms.

Develop content that positions the firm as a trusted accounting and strategic tax advisory partner.

Create targeted content for business owners, high-income professionals, and high-net-worth individuals.

Develop professional case studies, client success stories, and educational marketing materials, subject to client consent and confidentiality requirements.

Assist with webinars, educational workshops, seminars, and client events.

Maintain consistent brand messaging, professional standards, and visual identity across all marketing channels.

Coordinate approval of technical accounting and tax-related content with firm leadership before publication.



7. Digital Advertising & Paid Campaigns



Assist in developing and managing paid digital advertising campaigns.

Identify opportunities to generate qualified leads through Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and Meta Ads.

Develop targeted advertising campaigns for the firm's high-value services.

Coordinate advertising content, landing pages, and conversion tracking.

Monitor advertising expenditures, cost per lead, and campaign performance.

Recommend improvements based on advertising performance and return on investment.



8. Marketing Analytics & Performance Reporting

Monitor marketing expenditures and return on investment.

Prepare weekly and monthly marketing performance reports.

Evaluate the effectiveness of marketing channels and campaigns.

Identify high-performing campaigns and recommend improvements.

Provide actionable recommendations to firm leadership.

Continuously improve marketing strategies based on measurable results.

Required Qualifications



Bachelor's degree in Marketing from a recognized college or university in the Philippines.

Minimum of three years of professional digital marketing experience.

Demonstrated marketing experience supporting U.S.-based businesses or professional service organizations.

Proven experience in lead generation, business development, and client acquisition.

Strong experience in digital marketing strategy, campaign development, and campaign management.

Experience with CRM systems and marketing automation.

Hands-on experience with HubSpot CRM.

Experience with Constant Contact or comparable
 marketing platforms.

Proficiency in Canva and professional marketing content development.

Strong knowledge of SEO, website optimization, and digital marketing analytics.

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Strong analytical, project management, and organizational skills.

Ability to work independently, take initiative, and manage multiple marketing projects.

Ability to demonstrate measurable results from previous marketing campaigns.



Preferred Qualifications



Experience working with U.S.-based CPA firms, accounting firms, financial advisory firms, tax advisory firms, or other professional service organizations.



Experience marketing high-value professional services.



Experience marketing to business owners, physicians, executives, real estate investors, high-income professionals, and high-net-worth individuals.



Experience with B2B and B2C lead generation strategies.



Experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator and LinkedIn outreach campaigns.



Experience managing Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, or Meta Ads campaigns.



Experience with WordPress or similar website management platforms.



Proficiency in Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console.



Experience with Google Business Profile optimization and local SEO.



Experience developing marketing funnels, landing pages, and conversion optimization strategies.



Familiarity with practice management systems such as Qount.



Experience using AI-powered marketing, content development, and productivity tools.



Our Current Technology Stack



We currently utilize the following platforms:



Canva – Marketing design, branding, and content development.

Constant Contact –
 marketing, newsletters, and client engagement.

HubSpot – CRM, prospect tracking, and lead management, currently utilized by our payroll department.

Qount – Practice management, proposals, workflow management, and client onboarding.



The successful candidate will be expected to leverage and optimize our existing technology platforms, identify opportunities for improved integration and automation, and recommend additional solutions where appropriate.



What We Are Looking For



We are looking for a marketing professional who is:

Proactive, creative, and results-driven.

Strategic in thinking and hands-on in execution.

Comfortable taking ownership of marketing and business development initiatives.

Analytical and data-driven.

Highly organized and detail-oriented.

An excellent communicator.

Committed to professionalism, integrity, and confidentiality.

Committed to continuous improvement and professional development.

Capable of working independently with minimal supervision.

Comfortable presenting ideas, strategies, and recommendations to firm leadership.

Focused on generating qualified business opportunities and measurable revenue growth.



We are not simply looking for someone to manage social media or create marketing content. We are looking for a marketing professional who can take ownership of our marketing initiatives, generate qualified business opportunities, and contribute directly to the growth and long-term success of our firm.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)



Success in this position will be measured by:

Number of qualified leads generated.

Number of qualified prospective client consultations scheduled.

Lead-to-client conversion rates.

Marketing-generated revenue.

New recurring business clients acquired.

New strategic tax advisory clients acquired.

Cost per qualified lead.

Client acquisition costs.

Website traffic and conversion rates.

Organic search performance and keyword rankings.

title: Long-Term AI Studio Click Operator (No Experience, Chill Work, Weekly Pay + Bonus)
description:
Hello, my name is Bartosz.

You do not need any experience in AI, video editing, or marketing. You will never have to edit timelines, write scripts, attend endless meetings, or spend a single peso on software. We give you paid Google Flow accounts and our own super clean 1-click workspace. You can put on your headphones, listen to your favorite music or podcasts, and work in peace at your own rhythm.



Even though the vibe is relaxed, we are building a serious long-term team. We need people who can commit at least 25 to 40 hours per week (part-time or full-time, ideally full-time) and want to stay with us for months and years, making sure every clip we produce is clean and well done.



What we offer and how you get paid:

- Clear per-clip rate with strong earning potential: we pay $0.014 USD per approved clip. Working smoothly across 2 or 3 Chrome tabs at once, our operators average 150 to 210+ clips per hour, which works out to roughly $2.20 to $3.00+ USD/hour (and up to $3.50+/hour with bonuses).

- Real full-time monthly income: putting in 7 to 8 hours a day consistently brings in $400 to $600+ USD per month, with extra weekly bonuses ($15 to $45/week) for hitting volume targets with 95%+ clean accuracy.

- Grow with a fast-scaling company: we launch new campaigns every week, so there is always plenty of work in the queue, plus higher per-clip tiers ($0.016 to $0.018/clip) and team-lead opportunities for our most reliable operators.

- Instant transparency: every clip you upload adds directly to the live "You Have Earned" counter at the top of your workspace screen.

- Paid every Friday: fast, reliable payouts via Wise, PayPal, or GCash, starting right from your paid 15-minute trial batch.



Your exact step-by-step task:

1. Open a task card in our Clip Workspace.

2. Copy the ready-made text prompt and download the attached reference image.

3. Paste both into Google Flow using the exact model setting shown on the card.

4. When the 6 to 10 second clip finishes, do a 5-second quality check: make sure all spoken words are clear from start to finish and there are no weird AI hands or distorted product labels. If something looks off, simply click regenerate before uploading.

5. Drag and drop the clean MP4 clip into our workspace and move on to the next card.



Requirements:

- At least 25+ hours per week availability (full-time 35 to 40 hours/week is a big plus) and a desire for long-term stability.

- Good eye for quality: you take pride in submitting clean clips every time.

- Reliable laptop or PC (8GB+ RAM) and stable 25+ Mbps internet connection.

- Friendly, honest communication in written English.

Send me a message here on OnlineJobs.ph and start your first line with the word PINEAPPLE so I know you read everything carefully.

1. Your first name, where you are based in the Philippines, and how many hours per week you want to work (30h, 40h, etc.).

2. Have you used Chrome-based tools or AI websites before? (Beginners are 100% welcome!)

Bartosz

Across both:



- Meet agreed turnaround times

- Take feedback well and apply it consistently

- Communicate clearly about briefs, questions, revisions and deadlines

- Keep files organised and follow our naming and delivery processes



Ideal Requirements



- 2+ years of professional photo editing experience

- Portfolio required, ideally with wedding work AND commercial work (food, corporate, product, real estate, sport or similar)

- Advanced Adobe Lightroom and strong Adobe Photoshop skills

- Proven experience editing high-volume wedding galleries

- A strong eye for natural colour and accurate skin tones

- Excellent written English communication

- Highly organised, reliable and deadline-driven

- Reliable high-speed internet, a capable computer, and a colour-calibrated monitor



Nice to have (not required)



- Experience editing for Australian or international photographers or agencies

- Familiarity with light, airy, true-to-colour wedding styles

- Experience with food, hospitality or product retouching

- Familiarity with tools like Aftershoot, Imagen or Photo Mechanic for culling

- Basic video editing skills (a bonus, not a must)



What We Offer



- Full-time, long-term role with a stable, growing team

- Varied, interesting work. No two weeks look the same

- Paid time off, annual & sick leave

- Years of experience in each: weddings, and commercial or other industries

- The software you use and your skill level in each

title: Social Media Sales & Engagement Specialist
description:

**Part-time | 20 hours/week | $600 USD/month, with the opportunity to earn additional performance-based bonuses.**

Somia is an international health and wellness education company looking for an experienced, empathetic and sales-minded individual to take primary ownership of direct messages and comments across our three Instagram accounts.



You'll be an integral member of our international team, building relationships with our audience, helping prospective customers understand our programs and converting genuine interest into sales through thoughtful, personalized conversations.

- Respond to DMs and comments across all three Instagram accounts with warmth, accuracy and attention to detail.

- Track and report weekly on DM sales performance, common objections, successful sales approaches and opportunities for improvement.

- Develop and improve sales approaches, response guidelines, SOPs and FAQs.

- Help other team members improve their customer support and conversational sales skills.

- Stay informed about our programs, offers and ongoing marketing campaigns.

- Share valuable customer insights, testimonials, personal stories and recurring questions with the wider team.

- Assist with developing responses for Instagram Stories Q&As over time.



## Qualifications



- Demonstrated experience in customer support and conversational sales.

- Experience converting customer conversations into purchases through DMs or live chat.

- Experience managing a high volume of customer conversations across social media accounts.

- Exceptional written English and interpersonal communication skills.

- Strong emotional intelligence and the ability to handle sensitive conversations with empathy, confidence and appropriate boundaries.

- Ability to analyze sales conversations, identify patterns and improve sales and customer support processes.

- Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail and sound judgment.

- Ability to take initiative, work independently and collaborate effectively within a team.



A background in psychology, counselling, health and wellness, or experience working with coaching businesses, online education programs or memberships is highly desirable.



## Working hours



20 hours per week, spread across 5 days, with a split-shift schedule:



- Evening shift: 9–11 p.m. Philippine time.

- Midday shift: Approximately one hour around noon Philippine time.

- Flexible hours: Two additional hours per week.

- Every weekday + 1 weekend per month.



Reporting, analysis, team communication and process improvements are included within the 20 weekly hours.



Flexibility to adjust working hours and provide weekend coverage, particularly during marketing campaigns, is essential.



Attendance at weekly team meetings.



## What we're looking for



We want someone who genuinely enjoys connecting with people, understands the psychology of sales and takes pride in providing exceptional customer service.



You should be comfortable taking ownership of our DM and comment operations, identifying opportunities for improvement and helping the entire team become more effective at supporting customers and generating sales.



## How to apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. Briefly describe your most relevant customer support experience, particularly in environments where customers' needs were personal, sensitive or emotionally complex.

2. What experience do you have generating sales through DMs or live chat? Please be specific about what you were selling and your responsibilities.

3. Confirm that you are comfortable with the compensation and working hours outlined in this posting, and let us know when you would be available to start.



### Video introduction



Please share a short unscripted video of yourself (up to 3 minutes) answering the following questions:



1. What are you looking for in your next role? If this position turned out to be a great fit for you, what would that look like six months from now?



2. Many of the people who reach out to us are dealing with chronic illness or other difficult personal circumstances and want to learn more about our programs. How would you approach these conversations, and what do you think makes someone particularly effective at turning genuine interest into sales?

title: Google Business Profile Content Manager
description:
About the Role

Collaborates with: SEO Team, Design Team, and Local Market Leads

High-Volume Publishing & Calendar Management



Plan, build, and schedule 3 weekly posts across all 125 GBP pages (303 weekly posts for Drip Hydration; 72 weekly posts for ConciergeMD), keeping each brand's voice, branding, and assets strictly separate.

UTM Tracking & Link Auditing

Qualifications & Skills

Strong Localization Copywriting: Ability to take a core topic and rewrite it creatively so it feels genuinely local across 125 different US cities.

title: Founding Local SEO Strategist (Full-Time, Remote, up to $2,500/mo)
description:
Remote · Full-time · Up to $2,500/mo to start, with a clear path up



Read this part first

Most SEO job posts are written by people who can't tell a good SEO from a bad one. This one isn't. I've run the campaigns myself, I've built the systems, and I know exactly what "good" looks like, so I'm going to be direct about who I want.



I want someone who owns it. Someone who ranks local businesses for a living, treats a stalled campaign as a puzzle instead of a reason to wait for instructions, and tells us what's happening before anyone has to ask.



I'll also be straight about the job. It's fast, it's full-time, and you'll carry real client results. If you want to be told what to do every morning, or you're looking for something on the side, this isn't it, and that's fine.



Who we are

We're a US SEO agency helping local businesses, mostly home-service contractors (roofing, HVAC, fencing, concrete, cleaning), rank at the top of Google Maps and Google search. US clients. We already have the structure: documented SOPs, a written checklist for every client, and Claude Code doing a lot of the heavy lifting.



The role

This is our founding SEO seat. You own SEO delivery for a set group of client accounts: the website pages, content, indexing and link strategy. You work a steady weekly rhythm from our written process: plan the week on Monday, work the checklist Tuesday to Friday, post what moved. You report to our operations manager and work with me on strategy.



You run our process and make it stronger. You don't throw it out and build your own. When you find a better way, you test it, write down what changed and why, and it becomes the new standard.



What you'll own

- SEO delivery for your client accounts, start to finish

- Service pages and city pages that target one keyword each, built to rank and convert

- Finding out why a ranking dropped and fixing the cause, not the symptom

- Getting new pages and links indexed, and not submitting a URL before the page is actually live

- Link building with judgment: relevant, local, natural anchors

- Taking our SOPs and making them measurably stronger, then documenting what you changed

- Using AI (Claude, APIs) so nobody does the same manual task twice



Who you are

- Native-level English. You'll write updates every day and sometimes talk to clients. Non-negotiable.

- An over-communicator. This is the one I care about most. I want too many updates, not too few. If you're stuck or behind, you say so the same day.

- A problem-solver with no ego. You hit a wall, you research it, you test your way out, then you tell us what you learned.

- Someone who stays. This is a long-term seat. I want someone I can grow with for years.



What you've actually done

- Ranked multiple local businesses into the Google Maps 3-pack and kept them there. Not "worked on." Ranked. You can walk me through the lever you pulled and the position that moved.

- Built and fixed service and city pages on real sites.

- Used AI every day and caught it when it was wrong.

- Worked on a team before. You know how to hand off, document and follow a process someone else wrote.



Quick one so I know you actually read this: what's your favorite vegetable, and why? Put the answer at the very top of your application.



What I offer

- Up to $2,500/mo to start, growing as you take on more clients and more ownership.

- A real path to running SEO here as the team grows.

- Real ownership. No bureaucracy. You own SEO results and you'll feel it.



Logistics

- Full-time, remote.

- At least 4 hours of daily overlap with US Eastern. Tell me your timezone and normal working hours in your application.

- Start date: as soon as we find the right person.



How to apply

Put your answers to these in your application. Yes, I read every one:

- Your favorite vegetable and why (from above)

- Your name and age

- What motivates you. Be brutally honest. "Money" is a fine answer if it's the true one.

- Your local SEO experience

- The coolest thing you've ever done with SEO

- One technical answer: a roofer's Google Business Profile is stuck at position 8 in the map pack. What's the first thing you'd change, and why that before anything else?

title: Technical Support Specialist
description:
• Pay: USD 950 a month base, plus performance incentives. Our top performers take home about USD 1,100 to 1,200 a month.

• Shift: Monday to Friday, US Eastern daytime in staggered shifts between 8 AM and 8 PM, with some weekend shifts and on-call turns (a night shift in Manila)

• Benefits: HMO from your third month, flexible paid time off

• Where: fully remote



THE JOB

Our patients are mostly older adults at home in the US with heart failure or COPD. They see their care team by video on a tablet we send them, and their pulse oximeter and blood pressure monitor send readings to us. When something stops working, you are the person who fixes it, often by walking a patient who is not comfortable with technology through it one step at a time.



You take about 50 calls a day from patients and clinicians: a tablet that will not join a visit, a device that stopped sending readings, a clinician who needs help in Athenahealth. You own each problem until it is solved, and you write clear reports for our engineers when something needs a fix on their side.



ABOUT ANSIBLEHEALTH

AnsibleHealth is a US medical group for people living with serious heart and lung disease, such as heart failure and COPD. Health systems and health plans send us their patients, often right after a hospital stay. Our own doctors, nurse practitioners, nurses and respiratory therapists then look after them at home by video and phone: we adjust medicines, treat flare-ups early, teach patients and their families, and are on call day and night. The goal is fewer trips back to the hospital. We were founded in 2021, are backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, First Round Capital and AlleyCorp, and our team works across the United States and the Philippines.



WHAT YOU NEED



• 2 or more years in technical or customer support where you solved technology problems for customers

• Tech savviness: you pick up new devices and tools quickly (Android tablets, Zoom, Google Workspace)

• A friendly, patient way of helping older adults in the US, in clear English

• Reliable high-speed internet and availability for this shift for the long term

Experience with Samsung Knox or another device-management tool, remote monitoring devices, Athenahealth, or an issue tracker such as GitLab is a plus.

1. Apply only at 
 . Applications sent any other way are not reviewed.

2. Answer a few quick questions, including one troubleshooting scenario. When the form asks for the word from this posting, type TABLET.

3. Record your voice on the form: read three lines from a real support call, then talk a patient through joining his visit (about five minutes).

 you a link to book a 15-minute call with our recruiter.

title: Remote Operations Assistant: Morning Shift (Part-Time) | Tucson Supreme Clean
description:
Remote Operations Assistant (Part-Time, Morning Shift)



Tucson Supreme Clean is a residential cleaning company in Tucson, Arizona. We do deep cleans, moving cleans and recurring home cleanings across Tucson and the surrounding towns. We're hiring one person to run our morning operations: make sure every cleaner shows up, every client feels taken care of, and problems get solved before they turn into bigger ones.



This job is for people who think, not just follow steps.



We'll give you training, scripts and a dashboard that shows what's happening in real time. But no morning goes exactly to plan. A cleaner gets a flat tire. A client changes the scope at the door. Two jobs run long at the same time. Nobody will hand you a rule for every situation, and that's on purpose. We want someone who understands what we're trying to do, figures out the best move, makes the call, and tells us what they did.



If you'd rather be told exactly what to do at every step, this isn't the right fit. If you like owning the outcome and solving problems, you'll do well here, and the pay reflects that.



Pay



$200 per week, paid weekly

Bonuses for Google reviews and for keeping recurring clients, and they grow the longer you're with us



Schedule



Monday to Friday, 8:00am to 12:30pm Arizona time (22.5 hours a week)

Optional Saturdays for extra pay

You need to be fully available for the whole shift, every shift. If you have another job during these hours, this role isn't for you.



What you'll own



Getting every cleaner to their job on time, and stepping in fast when someone isn't on the way

Covering call-outs: finding a replacement or working out a new time with the client so nobody is left waiting

Answering every client and cleaner text and call quickly during your shift

Keeping clients informed when plans change, before they have to ask

Finding out what each first-time client cares about most and making sure the cleaners know

Joining live video walkthroughs at the end of first-time cleanings, as a second set of eyes

Checking in with clients after their cleanings and catching small problems before they become cancellations

Handling complaints: getting the cleaners' side, working out what happened and getting it fixed

In the job application there will be a code word. You will know it's a code word because the context doesn't fit.

Keeping our recurring clients happy, because clients who stay are what this business is built on

Organizing before and after photos and running reference checks on cleaner applicants



What you need



Strong spoken and written English. You'll be on the phone with American clients every day.

Good judgment. You can tell when to handle something yourself and when to bring it to the owner.

Basic AI skills: you know how to write a good prompt in ChatGPT, Claude or similar tools.

A computer (not just a phone), a headset with a microphone, and a quiet place to work

Stable internet and a backup plan for internet or power outages

You stay calm when things go wrong. Mornings get busy, and you'll be the one fixing problems.

Experience in customer service, dispatch or operations is a plus, but how you think matters more than your resume.

title: Fashion Collage Creator (TikTok)
description:
Only apply if you know streetwear / men's fashion and can edit outfit images with Photoshop or AI.



Applications without the exact subject line below are deleted automatically.



About the Role



We run fashion e-commerce brands that grow only through organic TikTok slideshows, and our content gets millions of views.



Our slideshows are outfit collages: clothing pieces and lifestyle items laid out on a clean background, with a short caption on each slide. Your job is to create new versions of our best slideshows (swap items, rebuild outfits, adjust the end slides) and post them on our new TikTok accounts.

-Posting daily on 12+ TikTok accounts with trending sounds

-Strong with Photoshop and/or AI image tools (Canva and CapCut a plus)

-On TikTok every day, you follow streetwear trends

-Running a fashion or outfit account, or making TikTok slideshows, is a big plus

-Reliable, available 4 hours a day, 6 days a week, good written English



Compensation



-Part-time to start: 4 hours a day, 6 days a week, $4/hour (around $415/month)

-Bonus on every video that passes 100,000 views: $10 at 100K, $20 at 200K, $100 at 1M, no cap

-Room to go full-time as we add more accounts

-Links to fashion / outfit accounts you run or have worked on (TikTok or Instagram), if you have any

description:

We are looking for someone who understands SEO fundamentals and is passionate about the evolution of search, including Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO).



**Responsibilities:**



- Conduct AI search visibility audits across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Google AI Overviews, and Google AI Mode.

- Research and identify why competitors are being recommended over our clients.

- Identify citation sources, directories, publications, and third-party websites influencing AI-generated recommendations.

- Conduct prompt gap analysis and identify opportunities for increased AI search visibility.

- Research and implement entity optimization strategies.

- Identify opportunities to improve brand mentions, citations, and topical authority.

- Optimize website content for traditional and AI-powered search engines.

- Identify and implement relevant structured data and schema markup.

- Develop strategies to strengthen client expertise, experience, authority, and trustworthiness (E-E-A-T).

- Coordinate with our SEO, content, and link-building teams to execute optimization strategies.

- Track AI search visibility, competitor performance, brand mentions, and citations.

- Research, test, and document emerging AI search optimization techniques.

- Help develop repeatable processes that can be implemented across multiple client accounts.



**Requirements:**



- Strong understanding of traditional SEO.

- Understanding of GEO, AEO, and AI-powered search platforms.

- Experience with keyword research and competitive analysis.

- Familiarity with Ahrefs, Google Search Console, and Google Analytics.

- Understanding of technical SEO, structured data, entities, and topical authority.

- Strong analytical and research skills.

- Excellent written English.

- Ability to work independently, follow established processes, and identify new opportunities.



**Preferred Qualifications:**



- Experience working with a digital marketing or SEO agency.

- Experience with local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization.

- Experience with AI visibility tracking tools.

- Familiarity with WordPress.

- Experience developing SEO workflows, SOPs, or AI-powered automations.



**To Apply:**



Please provide answers to the following questions:



1. What is the relationship between traditional SEO and AI search optimization?

2. How would you determine why ChatGPT recommends a competitor instead of one of our clients?

3. What specific actions would you take to improve a local business's visibility in AI-generated recommendations?

4. How would you measure the success of an AI search optimization campaign?

5. Please provide examples of relevant SEO or AI search optimization work you have completed.



We are looking for someone who can think critically, conduct meaningful research, and turn findings into actionable strategies.



This is a part-time, long-term remote position with the opportunity to grow into a full-time role.

- Match incoming client payments to the correct invoices and maintain accurate Accounts Receivable (A/R) records.

- Prepare and send invoices for monthly retainers and project-based services.

- At least 2 years of hands-on bookkeeping experience.

- Experience managing contractor payments and maintaining 1099 documentation.

- Excellent attention to detail and strong analytical skills.

- Experience using Mercury or similar online banking platforms.

### What We're Looking For

We are looking for a detail-oriented and reliable Amazon Virtual Assistant to support our e-commerce operations, particularly in inventory monitoring, removal order tracking, customer review monitoring, and product performance reporting.

1. Amazon Customer Review Monitoring

- Monitor customer reviews across assigned Amazon ASINs.

- Review and classify customer feedback, particularly new 1-star and 2-star reviews.

- Identify potential violations of Amazon Community Guidelines and Customer Review Policies.

- Collect screenshots and supporting evidence for qualifying policy violations.

2. Amazon Removal Order Tracking

- Generate and review Amazon Removal Order Detail reports covering the last 365 days.

title: Technical Support Specialist
description:
• Pay: USD 950 a month base, plus performance incentives. Our top performers take home about USD 1,100 to 1,200 a month.

• Shift: Monday to Friday, US Eastern daytime in staggered shifts between 8 AM and 8 PM, with some weekend shifts and on-call turns (a night shift in Manila)

• Benefits: HMO from your third month, flexible paid time off

• Where: fully remote



THE JOB

Our patients are mostly older adults at home in the US with heart failure or COPD. They see their care team by video on a tablet we send them, and their pulse oximeter and blood pressure monitor send readings to us. When something stops working, you are the person who fixes it, often by walking a patient who is not comfortable with technology through it one step at a time.



You take about 50 calls a day from patients and clinicians: a tablet that will not join a visit, a device that stopped sending readings, a clinician who needs help in Athenahealth. You own each problem until it is solved, and you write clear reports for our engineers when something needs a fix on their side.



ABOUT ANSIBLEHEALTH

AnsibleHealth is a US medical group for people living with serious heart and lung disease, such as heart failure and COPD. Health systems and health plans send us their patients, often right after a hospital stay. Our own doctors, nurse practitioners, nurses and respiratory therapists then look after them at home by video and phone: we adjust medicines, treat flare-ups early, teach patients and their families, and are on call day and night. The goal is fewer trips back to the hospital. We were founded in 2021, are backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, First Round Capital and AlleyCorp, and our team works across the United States and the Philippines.



WHAT YOU NEED



• 2 or more years in technical or customer support where you solved technology problems for customers

• Tech savviness: you pick up new devices and tools quickly (Android tablets, Zoom, Google Workspace)

• A friendly, patient way of helping older adults in the US, in clear English

• Reliable high-speed internet and availability for this shift for the long term

Experience with Samsung Knox or another device-management tool, remote monitoring devices, Athenahealth, or an issue tracker such as GitLab is a plus.
